paper.title: HSRM: Hidden-State Reward Models for Test-Time Verification
paper.abstract: Large language models can often generate plausible mathematical reasoning traces, but reliably identifying the correct solution among multiple candidates remains a key challenge. Existing test-time reasoning pipelines typically rely on text-based verifiers that re-read each generated solution, making verification an expensive component of inference. Prior work has shown, however, that LLMs often encode correctness-related signals in their internal representations, including awareness of when the

summary.core_problem: 解决 test-time reasoning 中候选解验证成本过高的问题，尤其是文本 verifier 需要重新读取每条解答，推理开销大。
summary.importance: 这是 test-time verification 与轻量 reward modeling 的方法工作。它的重要性在于把“正确性判断”从文本重读转向生成器内部表征读取，若结论稳健，会影响后训练和推理时 reranking 的接口设计。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 HSRM（Hidden-State Reward Model）。方法从冻结的生成器中，在 reasoning step 边界提取 hidden states，用一个小型 Transformer encoder 对候选解进行排序，而不是让 verifier 再读一遍文本。训练数据来自模型自生成轨迹及 outcome labels，不需要人工偏好标注。核心假设是：生成器内部已经编码了与答案正确性相关的信号，外部 verifier 只需把这些信号读出来。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模，但实验设定应是数学推理场景下，对比文本 verifier、可能还有 self-consistency 或 outcome reward baselines。关键指标通常包括 best-of-N 选择准确率、最终解题正确率和额外推理成本。论文声称在无需人工过程监督的前提下，用更低成本实现有效候选排序。是否真正成立，要看 hidden-state extractor 的泛化、跨模型迁移，以及与同等 FLOPs 文本 verifier 的公平对比。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Queen’s University。该工作延续了“模型内部存在自知错误信号”的一类研究脉络，但这里把它具体化为 test-time reward model。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles the high cost of test-time verification in reasoning, where text-based verifiers must reread every candidate solution.
summary_en.importance: This is a test-time verification and lightweight reward-modeling paper. Its importance lies in shifting correctness judgment from text re-reading to internal-state reading, which could change the interface between post-training and inference-time reranking if the result holds up.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes HSRM, a Hidden-State Reward Model. It extracts hidden states from a frozen generator at reasoning-step boundaries and feeds them into a small Transformer encoder to rank candidate solutions, instead of using a verifier that rereads the text. Training uses self-generated trajectories with outcome labels, requiring no human-written process supervision. The core hypothesis is that correctness-related signals already exist inside the generator and only need to be read out.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, but the setup is clearly in mathematical reasoning, likely compared against text verifiers, self-consistency, and outcome-reward baselines. The key metrics should be best-of-N selection accuracy, final solve rate, and added inference cost. The claim is that effective candidate ranking can be achieved at lower cost without human process labels. The real test is whether the hidden-state reader generalizes, transfers across generators, and is compared fairly against text verifiers at matched compute.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from Queen’s University. It follows the line of research suggesting that LLMs internally encode signals about their own correctness, but turns that idea into a concrete test-time reward model.

recommendation.zh: 值得看，因为它把 verifier 接口从 text 改成 hidden state，这对 post-train 和 serving 都有味道；但先别太信，重点检查是否只是同模型内的 readout 泄漏优势。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it changes the verifier interface from text to hidden state, which matters for both post-training and serving; but check carefully whether the gains are mostly same-model readout leakage.

paper.title: Why Summaries Turn Neutral: Policy Attribution for Sentiment Drift in Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF) aligns LLMs with human preferences, improving summarization fluency and safety, but causes sentiment drift: overly neutral summaries stripped of emotional nuance. We diagnose why RL acts as a sentiment neutralizer and present Policy Attribution, a framework using gradient and logit decomposition to trace drift to reward model (RM) signals and KL (Kullback-Leibler) penalty. Sentiment drift reflects a strategic bias toward "low-risk" tokens maximiz

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究 RLHF 在摘要任务中为何会系统性地把情感色彩压平，生成更中性、低波动的摘要。
summary.importance: 重要性在于它不是单纯报告一个对齐副作用，而是试图把副作用归因到具体训练信号：奖励模型偏好与 KL 约束如何共同把策略推向“低风险 token”。这类分析对理解 post-train 如何反向塑造模型分布有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Policy Attribution，用梯度与 logit 分解去追踪情感漂移来自哪里，重点拆分奖励模型信号和 KL penalty 对 token 选择的贡献；并进一步加入 sentiment-aware regularization，试图在不损害摘要质量的前提下保留更多情感信息。
summary.experiments: 实验在 Reddit TL;DR 和 CNN/DailyMail 上进行，并做了 8 种语言的跨语言分析。论文报告 RLHF 摘要虽然获得更高 reward，但情感方差下降 30-40%；加入情感感知正则后，情感漂移可降低 18-22%，同时摘要质量基本不受损。摘要未给出模型规模与完整训练配置，结论更像现象诊断而非大规模 recipe 结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why RLHF systematically neutralizes sentiment in summarization, producing outputs with reduced emotional variance.
summary_en.importance: Its value is not the observation alone, but the attempt to attribute the drift to concrete training signals: reward-model preferences and the KL constraint jointly pushing the policy toward low-risk tokens. This is relevant for understanding how post-training reshapes the model distribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose Policy Attribution, using gradient and logit decomposition to trace sentiment drift to specific components, mainly the reward model and KL penalty. They also add a sentiment-aware regularizer to preserve affective content without hurting summary quality.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on Reddit TL;DR and CNN/DailyMail, plus cross-lingual analysis over eight languages. RLHF summaries achieve higher reward but show 30-40% lower sentiment variance; the proposed regularization reduces drift by 18-22% with little quality loss. The abstract does not specify model scale or full training setup, so the paper reads more like a diagnosis study than a large-scale recipe result.

recommendation.zh: 可当作 RLHF 副作用案例库来看：结论不太改变主流 prior，但“RM+KL 把分布推向低风险 token”这个拆解值得记，正文看归因图表就够。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a useful RLHF side-effect case study: it does not really overturn priors, but the RM+KL-to-low-risk-token attribution is worth noting; the attribution figures are the main thing to read.

paper.title: MuseCritic: Learning Multi-Aspect Song Rewards through Natural-Language Aesthetic Critiques
paper.abstract: Long-form song generation models continue to improve in duration, structural integrity, and acoustic complexity, making reliable aesthetic rewards increasingly important for aligning these models with human preferences. However, reward models for complete songs remain limited, and existing evaluators typically predict scores in a single forward pass without providing readable explanations. We introduce MUSECRITIC, a semi-scalar reward model that generates a natural-language critique covering fiv

summary.core_problem: 长歌曲生成模型的审美奖励模型缺乏可解释性，且现有直接预测标量分数的方法存在训练推理分布偏移，无法可靠对齐人类审美偏好。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出半标量奖励模型范式，用自然语言多维度审美批评作为中间表示预测奖励，缓解训练推理分布偏移问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MuseCritic，采用两阶段训练pipeline：1. 教师模型生成高质量多维度审美批评，用于监督微调奖励模型；2. 微调后的模型自生成批评进行奖励学习，缩小训练与推理的分布差异。
summary.experiments: 在SongEval的200首歌曲测试集上，宏观平均MSE从0.2875显著降低，同时输出可解释的五维度审美批评文本，提升了奖励模型的可解释性与准确性。
summary.authors_note: 复旦大学NLP团队，研究方向覆盖多模态生成与偏好对齐。

summary_en.core_problem: Aesthetic reward models for long-form song generation lack interpretability, and existing methods that directly predict scalar scores suffer from train-inference distribution shift, failing to reliably align with human aesthetic preferences.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a semi-scalar reward model paradigm that uses natural-language multi-dimensional aesthetic critiques as an intermediate representation to predict rewards, mitigating train-inference distribution shift.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes MuseCritic with a two-stage training pipeline: 1. A teacher model generates high-quality multi-dimensional aesthetic critiques for supervised fine-tuning of the reward model; 2. The fine-tuned model generates its own critiques for reward learning, reducing the distribution gap between training and inference.
summary_en.experiments: On a test set of 200 songs from SongEval, macro-averaged MSE is significantly reduced from 0.2875, while outputting interpretable five-dimensional aesthetic critique text, improving both the interpretability and accuracy of the reward model.
summary_en.authors_note: Fudan NLP Group from Fudan University, focusing on multimodal generation and preference alignment.

recommendation.zh: 用自然语言批评作为奖励模型中间表示的思路可迁移到文本RL，但核心是音乐领域，仅需了解范式即可。
recommendation.en: The idea of using natural-language critiques as an intermediate representation for reward models can transfer to text RL, but the work is music-domain specific; only the paradigm is worth knowing.

paper.title: Evaluator Ensembles Under Reward Hacking: Covariance Geometry and Finite-Search Guarantees
paper.abstract: Language-model judges and reward models enable scalable supervision, but finite optimization can exploit evaluator errors rather than improve response quality. We characterize this failure through the covariance geometry of evaluator ensembles. For calibrated judges, the ensemble mean retains common-mode error along the all-ones direction, whereas cross-judge disagreement captures only orthogonal error. Consequently, disagreement can be high despite robust aggregation, or low while shared respon

summary.core_problem: LLM judge/reward model 集成在有限优化下会被 reward hacking 利用——优化器利用 evaluator 的误差而非提升回复质量。
summary.importance: 理论分析：用 evaluator 集成的协方差几何刻画 reward hacking 失效模式，证明 common-mode error 不可从内部 judge 分数识别，并给出 best-of-K 选择的 overstatement 界。
summary.technical_approach: 在 joint sub-Gaussian 模型下分析集成的协方差结构：ensemble mean 保留 all-ones 方向的 common-mode error，cross-judge disagreement 只捕获正交误差。证明 common-mode error 不可识别，给出 best-of-K overstatement 和 target-quality regret 界，扩展到 predictably adaptive search。
summary.experiments: 纯理论工作，无模型实验；给出 best-of-K 项为 √(log K) 量级且在 Gaussian projected error 下渐近紧。
summary.authors_note: 无法从摘要确认机构或知名作者背景。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM judge/reward model ensembles are vulnerable to reward hacking under finite optimization—optimizers exploit evaluator errors rather than improving response quality.
summary_en.importance: Theoretical analysis: characterizes reward hacking failure via the covariance geometry of evaluator ensembles, proves common-mode error is non-identifiable from internal judge scores, and bounds best-of-K overstatement.
summary_en.technical_approach: Under a joint sub-Gaussian model, analyzes ensemble covariance: the ensemble mean retains common-mode error along the all-ones direction, while cross-judge disagreement captures only orthogonal error. Proves common-mode error non-identifiability, bounds best-of-K overstatement and target-quality regret, extending to predictably adaptive search.
summary_en.experiments: Purely theoretical, no model experiments; best-of-K terms scale as √(log K) and are asymptotically tight for Gaussian projected errors.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution and notable author background not identifiable from abstract.

recommendation.zh: 对 reward hacking 的协方差几何分析很干净，common-mode error 不可识别的结论直接影响 ensemble judge 的设计；看定理证明和 √(log K) 界的推导。
recommendation.en: The covariance-geometry analysis of reward hacking is clean; the non-identifiability of common-mode error directly affects ensemble judge design; read the theorem proofs and √(log K) bound derivation.

paper.title: Beyond Routing Weights: Faithful Response-Level Interpretation of Mixture-of-Experts Reward Models via Contribution Contrast
paper.abstract: Reward models are central to learning from human preferences, yet identifying what drives their predictions remains challenging. Recent sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) reward models seek to improve interpretability by routing prompts to specialized experts and characterizing experts through examples with high routing weights. However, routing weights only reveal which prompts an expert $\textit{receives}$, not how it $\textit{judges}$ responses, providing only a partial account of expert behavio

summary.core_problem: 解决 MoE reward model 的专家解释不忠实问题：router weight 只能说明样本被送到哪个专家，不能说明专家如何判断 chosen/rejected response。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 reward model 解释与诊断方法。它对 RLHF/RLVR 中 reward model 的可控性有参考价值，尤其是当 reward model 采用稀疏专家结构时，专家解释不能只看路由分布。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Contribution-Contrast, 简称 CoCo。它以 chosen-rejected response pair 为单位，寻找对某个专家贡献差异最大的样本，用“贡献对比”同时刻画 routing 行为和 preference scoring 行为。相比只按高 routing weight 找代表样本，CoCo 更接近专家对最终 reward 差异的实际作用。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在自动评估和人工评估中，CoCo 相比 router-based、score-based 和 sparse autoencoder-based 解释方法更 coherent、faithful、specialized，同时保持竞争性的 reward model 表现。摘要未给出模型规模、偏好数据集、提升幅度和人工评估协议细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies faithful interpretation of MoE reward models, where routing weights reveal which prompts an expert receives but not how the expert judges chosen-versus-rejected responses.
summary_en.importance: This is an interpretability and diagnostics contribution for preference modeling. It is relevant to RLHF and RLVR pipelines when reward models use sparse expert structure, because expert specialization cannot be inferred from routing alone.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, Contribution-Contrast or CoCo, identifies chosen-rejected response pairs with the largest contribution contrast for each expert. This jointly captures routing behavior and preference-scoring behavior, unlike representative-example methods based only on high routing weights.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports automatic and human evaluations showing more coherent, faithful, and specialized expert interpretations than router-based, score-based, and sparse-autoencoder-based alternatives, while preserving competitive reward model performance. Model size, datasets, and effect sizes are not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 做 MoE reward model 才需要看，重点读贡献分解定义；对基座训练只是弱诊断信号。
recommendation.en: Only read it if you run MoE reward models; focus on the contribution decomposition, as the signal for base pretraining is indirect.

paper.title: Sample-Adaptive Latent Rewards for Uncertainty-Guided Diffusion Post-Training
paper.abstract: Latent reward models can supervise visual diffusion models without decoding intermediate states into pixel space. This makes alignment with human preferences more efficient. However, existing latent reward models output only scalar scores. They do not estimate the uncertainty of each prediction. The generator therefore cannot determine which feedback is reliable. This can drive optimization in the wrong direction and lead to reward hacking. We propose \textsc{SURE}, a unified latent-space framew

summary.core_problem: 解决视觉 diffusion 后训练中 latent reward 只有标量分数、无法表达不确定性，进而导致奖励误导和 reward hacking 的问题。
summary.importance: 这属于生成模型后训练与奖励建模工作。虽然对象是图像/视频 diffusion，不是 LLM，但“奖励模型应显式建模置信度”这一点对 RLHF/RLVR 与 pretrain-posttrain 接口有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SURE 框架，在 latent space 中训练 sample-adaptive latent reward model（SURE-LRM），为每个 noisy latent 预测高斯效用分布，用均值表示奖励、方差表示不确定性；再通过 uncertainty-guided reward feedback learning 利用该分布指导 dense post-training，避免不可靠反馈主导优化。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明方法覆盖图像与视频 diffusion 模型，并强调无需将中间状态解码回像素空间即可进行对齐；但未在摘要中给出具体模型规模、数据规模、基线名称和提升幅度，因此结论强度仍需看正文实验表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a key weakness in diffusion post-training: latent reward models output scalar scores without uncertainty, which can misguide optimization and induce reward hacking.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training and reward-modeling paper for image/video diffusion. It is not an LLM paper, but the idea that reward models should expose confidence is relevant to RLHF/RLVR and the pretrain–posttrain interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes SURE, a latent-space framework with a sample-adaptive latent reward model (SURE-LRM) that predicts a Gaussian utility for each noisy latent. The mean is used as reward and the variance as uncertainty, which then drives uncertainty-guided reward feedback learning during dense post-training.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims applicability to both image and video diffusion models and emphasizes latent-space alignment without decoding intermediate states to pixels. However, it does not provide model sizes, dataset scales, baselines, or exact gains in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 论文，但“奖励分数必须带置信度”这个判断值得迁到 RM/RLVR；正文只需看不确定性如何进入优化目标。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but the claim that reward scores need calibrated uncertainty is worth porting to RM/RLVR; read only the objective design.

paper.title: Enhancing VLM Reward Models Through Structure-Aware Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: Designing effective reward functions remains a major bottleneck in Reinforcement Learning (RL). Recent work uses large foundation Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as reward models, computing text-observation similarity to bypass manual reward engineering. Although promising, these rewards are often noisy and unreliable, limiting their direct utility during deployment. We present Structure-Aware Fine-Tuning (SAFT), a simple, self-supervised method that refines these imperfect reward signals online w

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 VLM 作为视觉奖励模型时奖励信号不稳定的问题。现有方法常用图像-文本 embedding 的余弦相似度作为 dense reward，但这类 reward 容易受视觉扰动、状态别名和细粒度场景理解不足影响，导致 RL 训练中的奖励地形噪声较大。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接贡献有限，更接近 post-train / RL reward modeling 的方法论文。它的启发点在于：不一定要依赖人工偏好或真实奖励标签来修正 reward model，可以把任务结构作为训练信号，在线约束 VLM 表征空间。这对研究多模态 reward model、RLHF 信号质量、以及 VLM 作为环境反馈接口有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Structure-Aware Fine-Tuning，核心是在在线 RL 过程中用 LoRA 适配器微调 VLM reward model，而不是全量更新基础 VLM。原始 reward 来自视觉观察 embedding 与文本目标 embedding 的余弦相似度。SAFT 在此基础上加入任务内在结构约束，用 augmentation 和辅助损失正则化 VLM latent space，使相似状态、等价变换后的状态、以及符合任务进展关系的状态在 reward 表征上更一致。论文提到两个实例化机制 CAL 和 RLR，重点不是引入新的监督标签，而是用环境结构本身去降低 VLM reward 的噪声。相比 preference-based RL，它减少了人工比较标注；相比直接使用 frozen VLM，它能在任务分布上修正 reward landscape。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两个标准控制 benchmark 和两个高维机器人操作任务，并测试不同能力级别的基础 VLM。结果显示，SAFT 相比未微调的 VLM reward 能提升 policy sample efficiency，加快收敛，并让部分较小 VLM 在原本无法解决的任务上取得有效学习。论文还用 preference-based learning 设定评估人工标注需求，显示结构约束可以减少对 human labeling 的依赖。另一个关键结果是 SAFT 后的 reward prediction 与 ground-truth reward 更一致，说明收益不只是 policy optimization 的偶然改善，也来自 reward model 本身的去噪。提供的内容未包含具体分数、环境名称、模型参数量和提升百分比，精读时需要回到实验表格确认这些数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 15 分钟。重点看三个部分：第一，SAFT 的 loss 定义和 CAL / RLR 的具体构造，判断结构先验是否依赖任务手工设计；第二，online fine-tuning 的训练流程，尤其是 LoRA 更新频率、是否会引入 reward hacking、是否冻结 text encoder；第三，reward-ground truth alignment 的实验，比单纯 policy return 更能说明 reward model 是否真的变好。若只关心 LLM 预训练，可以跳过多数 RL benchmark 细节，保留它关于“弱监督 reward 信号如何被结构先验修正”的思路。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the instability of VLM-derived rewards in reinforcement learning. A common setup uses the cosine similarity between an observation embedding and a text-goal embedding as a dense reward, but this signal is often noisy, brittle under visual changes, and poorly aligned with fine-grained task progress.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper. Its relevance is mainly through the pretrain-posttrain interface: it studies how a pretrained multimodal model can be adapted into a usable reward model without dense human labels. The useful idea is that reward-model correction does not have to come only from preferences or ground-truth rewards; task structure can also provide a training signal for denoising latent representations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, Structure-Aware Fine-Tuning, adapts the VLM reward model online using LoRA adapters. The base reward is the image-text cosine similarity between the current observation and the goal description. SAFT adds auxiliary structure-aware objectives, implemented through augmentations and losses such as CAL and RLR, to regularize the VLM latent space. The goal is to make reward predictions consistent under task-preserving transformations and more faithful to the environment’s structural relations. Compared with frozen VLM rewards, it adapts the embedding space to the task distribution. Compared with preference-based RL, it reduces the need for human comparison labels.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans two standard control benchmarks and two high-dimensional robotic manipulation tasks, with several base VLM capability levels. SAFT improves sample efficiency, speeds up policy convergence, and enables smaller VLMs to solve tasks that were difficult for frozen baselines. The paper also evaluates a preference-learning setting and reports reduced human labeling needs. A separate reward-alignment analysis shows that the fine-tuned rewards become closer to ground-truth rewards, suggesting that the gains are not only due to downstream policy optimization. The provided text does not expose the exact scores, model sizes, or percentage gains, so those numbers should be checked in the experimental tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 15 minutes. Focus on the SAFT objective, especially how CAL and RLR encode task structure and whether these priors are generic or task-specific. Then inspect the online fine-tuning loop: LoRA placement, update frequency, frozen versus trainable encoders, and safeguards against reward drift. The reward-ground-truth alignment results are more informative than policy return alone. Readers focused on foundation-model training can skip most environment-specific RL details and keep the method as an example of structure-supervised reward-model adaptation.

recommendation.zh: 重点看§3的SAFT潜空间正则设计，思路可迁移到多模态对齐预训练的稳定正则项设计中。
recommendation.en: Focus on the SAFT latent space regularization design in §3 — the idea is transferable to stabilizing regularizers for multimodal alignment pretraining.

paper.title: Evaluation-Verification Reward for Consistent Multi-Reference Image Editing
paper.abstract: While recent image editing models have made rapid progress, multi-reference editing remains challenging, particularly in maintaining visual consistency across references and ensuring overall visual harmony. Reinforcement learning has proven highly effective for text-to-image generation and single-image editing, but its extension to multi-reference editing is hindered by the absence of suitable reward models that capture multi-image relational constraints. Moreover, naively using multimodal large

summary.core_problem: 多参考图像编辑任务中，现有RL奖励无法捕捉多图一致性约束，直接用MLLM做零样本评估存在幻觉与推理能力不足的矛盾。
summary.importance: 提出了评估-验证解耦的多维奖励机制EVR，为多模态生成RL提供了更可靠的奖励信号设计思路。
summary.technical_approach: 将奖励计算分解为两步：MLLM评估器针对每个视觉维度生成多个候选判断假设，验证器将每个主张锚定到具体视觉证据，通过证据匹配决定接受或拒绝假设，聚合得到最终奖励。
summary.experiments: 在多参考图像编辑任务上验证，相比直接使用MLLM打分的基线，生成结果的跨参考一致性、视觉和谐度均有提升。
summary.authors_note: 合作团队来自西安交通大学、阿里巴巴高德、上海交通大学。

summary_en.core_problem: For multi-reference image editing, existing RL rewards fail to capture cross-image consistency constraints, and directly using MLLMs as zero-shot evaluators faces a tension between hallucination in long reasoning and limited deductive power in short judgments.
summary_en.importance: Proposes EVR, a multi-dimensional evaluation-verification decoupled reward mechanism, providing a more reliable reward signal design pattern for multimodal generative RL.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decomposes reward computation into two steps: an MLLM evaluator generates multiple candidate hypotheses for each visual criterion, a verifier grounds each claim to concrete visual evidence to accept or reject it, then aggregates results for the final reward.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on multi-reference image editing tasks, showing improvements in cross-reference consistency and visual harmony over baselines using direct MLLM scoring.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is a collaboration between Xi'an Jiaotong University, Amap (Alibaba), and Shanghai Jiao Tong University.

recommendation.zh: 多模态生成RL奖励的增量改进，评估-验证解耦思路可供多模态对齐设计参考，看方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement on multimodal generative RL reward; the evaluator-verifier decomposition can inform multimodal alignment design, read the method section only.

paper.title: SeekJudge: A Practical Reward Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Computer-Use Agents
paper.abstract: Deciding whether a trajectory actually fulfills its instruction governs how we measure computer-use agents on long-horizon graphical-user-interface tasks and how we train them with reinforcement learning. This judgment has long relied on rule-based evaluation, which struggles to align with human intention and goes stale when an app updates or its online content drifts. Existing model-based judges attempt to address these problems but still leave a performance gap to the rule-based evaluation. We

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 computer-use agent 轨迹评判问题：给定用户指令和一段长 GUI 操作轨迹，如何判断任务是否真的完成，并把这个判断做成可用于强化学习的低成本、低延迟、细粒度 reward。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关系不强，但对 post-train/RL 系统有参考价值。它把 GUI agent 的 reward 从脆弱的规则评测转向模型评测，并强调 reward 模型必须同时满足三个条件：能定位关键证据、能读准视觉细节、能在在线 RL 中承担可接受的成本。这个问题和通用 agent 训练中的 verifier/reward 设计有关，尤其是长轨迹、多模态、稀疏成功信号场景。
summary.technical_approach: SeekJudge 的核心设计是把长轨迹判断拆成 localization 和 extraction。它没有把整条轨迹的多张截图一次性塞进 VLM，因为作者观察到，即使关键截图已经包含在输入里，额外加入更多同轨迹截图也会持续降低判断质量。框架由四类角色组成：Condense 负责压缩轨迹，Ground 负责把状态变化落到可检索的时间线，Seek 作为控制器在时间线上寻找关键证据，Analyze 每次只读取一张图并抽取高保真细节。Seek 和 Analyze 形成多轮循环，直到 Seek 得到足够证据后输出结论。工程上，所有角色共享一个专门训练的 9B 开源模型，避免依赖闭源大模型；同时提出异步 reward prefetch，在环境执行动作时提前完成部分评判计算，减少 rollout 被 reward model 阻塞的时间。
summary.experiments: 论文构建了 CUAStepBench 和 CUAStepBench-Long，包含密集人工标注的轨迹级和 step-level 标签，覆盖 177 个跨平台应用。实验重点不是只做离线 judge agreement，而是验证 reward 是否能改善下游 RL 后的任务成功率。结果显示，SeekJudge 作为模型化 reward 能匹配甚至超过原生规则监督；由于单次分析只读少量上下文，它还能处理更长轨迹。成本方面，使用单个 9B 开源模型，相比闭源大模型 judge 便宜数百倍；异步 prefetch 进一步降低在线 RL 中 reward 计算造成的等待时间。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–40 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对规则评测三类问题的拆解，以及 Figure 2 关于多图输入导致 VLM 判断退化的实验证据。Method 部分重点看 Condense/Ground/Seek/Analyze 的分工，以及 Seek–Analyze loop 为什么比单次多图前向更适合长 GUI 轨迹。实验部分优先看 CUAStepBench 的标注设计、step-level reward 的定义、下游 RL 成功率对比和异步 prefetch 的延迟收益。预训练研究员不必深读 GUI 环境细节，值得关注的是长轨迹 reward 建模中“先定位证据、再高精度读取”的设计取舍。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses trajectory judging for computer-use agents: given a user instruction and a long GUI interaction trace, decide whether the task was completed, and turn that decision into a practical reward signal for reinforcement learning.
summary_en.importance: The connection to foundation-model pretraining is indirect, but the work is useful for post-training and agent RL. It treats reward modeling as an operational system problem rather than a pure offline agreement problem. A usable judge must localize decisive evidence, read visual details accurately, and run cheaply enough inside online rollouts. This is relevant to verifier and reward design for long-horizon, multimodal agents with sparse success signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: SeekJudge decomposes long-trajectory evaluation into localization and extraction. The key observation is that feeding many screenshots into a single VLM pass can hurt judgment quality, even when the decisive screenshot is included. The framework uses four role-specialized agents sharing one 9B open-source backbone. Condense compresses the trajectory, Ground builds a compact state timeline, Seek acts as the controller and searches for the evidence it needs, and Analyze inspects one image at a time for high-fidelity visual extraction. Seek and Analyze interact in a loop before a final verdict is emitted. The system is also optimized for RL use: it supports fine-grained step-level scoring and uses asynchronous reward prefetching to overlap part of reward computation with environment execution.
summary_en.experiments: The authors build CUAStepBench and CUAStepBench-Long with dense human labels at both trajectory and step level, spanning 177 applications across platforms. The main empirical claim is downstream-oriented: SeekJudge as a model-based reward matches or surpasses native rule-based supervision in test success across applications. The decoupled design handles longer trajectories than single-pass judges. On efficiency, the system uses one specialized 9B open-source model and is reported to be hundreds of times cheaper than closed-source large-model judges; asynchronous prefetch reduces reward-model blocking time during rollouts.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–40 minute skim is enough. Focus on the Introduction for the limitations of rule-based evaluation and the Figure 2 evidence that multi-image VLM judging degrades as more trajectory images are added. In the Method section, read the Condense/Ground/Seek/Analyze decomposition and the Seek–Analyze loop. In the experiments, prioritize CUAStepBench construction, step-level reward labeling, downstream RL success comparisons, and latency/cost measurements for asynchronous prefetch. The GUI-specific environment details are less important than the broader reward-modeling pattern: localize evidence first, then extract details with a small high-quality context.

recommendation.zh: 多角色Agent裁判+蒸馏到单模型的设计对RLHF/Agent RL奖励建模有参考，重点看§3蒸馏流水线和§4 RL增益对比。
recommendation.en: The multi-role judge design plus distillation into a single model is informative for RLHF and agent RL reward modeling; focus on §3 distillation pipeline and §4 RL gain comparison.

paper.title: A Method for Learning Value Systems in Generative AI
paper.abstract: Value-aware AI systems require explicit computational representations of human values (groundings) and their aggregation into value systems in order to align their decisions with ours. As such representations are difficult to elicit, value learning seeks to infer them by observing human behaviour. This work addresses the lack of grounded value learning methods in generative AI: existing approaches typically replicate human preferences without awareness of the multidimensional structure of value

summary.core_problem: 现有生成式AI价值学习方法要么仅复制人类偏好而缺乏多维价值对齐结构，要么无原则性的价值系统引出方法，难以实现结构化价值对齐。
summary.importance: 方法创新（迁移已有价值系统学习框架到生成式AI场景），属于对齐领域的增量改进，为多维度价值对齐提供可解释的实现路径。
summary.technical_approach: 改编已验证的价值系统学习方法，基于成对prompt-response偏好数据，同时学习多目标奖励模型实现的价值基础表示，以及加权线性标量化形式的价值系统表示。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提及具体实验设置、模型规模及量化效果对比。
summary.authors_note: 西班牙胡安卡洛斯国王大学CETINIA研究中心

summary_en.core_problem: Existing value learning methods for generative AI either replicate human preferences without multidimensional value alignment structure, or lack principled value system elicitation, making structured value alignment difficult.
summary_en.importance: Incremental method innovation; adapts an existing value system learning framework to generative AI, providing an interpretable path for multidimensional value alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Adapts a validated value system learning method to simultaneously learn, from pairwise prompt-response preference data: 1) value grounding implemented as a multi-objective reward model, and 2) value system representation as weighted linear scalarization.
summary_en.experiments: No specific experimental setup, model scale, or quantitative performance comparison is mentioned in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: CETINIA, University Rey Juan Carlos, Spain

recommendation.zh: 增量式价值对齐方法迁移，无核心新洞察，仅作为对齐领域的文献备查即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental transfer of value alignment framework to generative AI, no core new insights, only for literature reference.

paper.title: LLM Evaluators are Biased across Languages
paper.abstract: LLM evaluators (trained reward models and prompted LLM-as-a-Judge) are routinely validated via pairwise accuracy. In a multilingual setting, this operates under the premise that high pairwise accuracy implies reliable, language-neutral scoring. We show that this assumption does not hold. We conduct experiments with semantically identical instruction-response pairs across 23 languages, and find that multilingual evaluators assign significantly different scores to different evaluation languages. T

summary.core_problem: 多语言场景下，LLM evaluator 在语义等价输入上是否真的语言中立，以及现有 pairwise accuracy 是否足以发现偏置。
summary.importance: 这是评测方法层面的重要修正。它不是预训练方法论文，但直接影响 reward model、LLM-as-a-Judge、多语言对齐和数据筛选的可信度。贡献在于揭示一个被主流验证协议掩盖的系统性偏差。
summary.technical_approach: 构造 23 种语言下语义相同的 instruction-response 对，比较 8 个开源 evaluator 与 frontier judges 的打分分布、接受率和统计显著性。核心论点是：pairwise accuracy 只看相对排序，无法约束跨语言绝对分数校准，因此会掩盖 global threshold 下的语言偏置。
summary.experiments: 在 23 种语言、8 个开源 evaluator 以及 frontier judges 上，作者发现偏差广泛存在且统计显著；低资源语言往往被打得更宽松。尽管 pairwise accuracy 超过 90%，在统一阈值下不同语言的 acceptance rate 差异最高可达 43%。实验设计干净，直接控制语义等价，是这篇论文最有价值的部分。
summary.authors_note: University of Cambridge Language Technology Lab 的评测研究。Anna Korhonen 是该方向知名学者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLM evaluators are truly language-neutral on semantically identical inputs, and whether pairwise accuracy is sufficient to detect multilingual bias.
summary_en.importance: This is an important correction to evaluation methodology. It is not a pretraining paper, but it directly affects the trustworthiness of reward models, LLM-as-a-Judge pipelines, multilingual alignment, and data filtering. The contribution is exposing a systematic bias hidden by standard validation protocols.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build semantically identical instruction-response pairs across 23 languages and compare score distributions, acceptance rates, and statistical significance for eight open-weight evaluators plus frontier judges. The key argument is that pairwise accuracy only constrains relative ranking, not cross-language absolute calibration, so it can hide language bias under a global threshold.
summary_en.experiments: Across 23 languages, eight open evaluators, and frontier judges, the bias is widespread and statistically significant; lower-resource languages are often scored more generously. Despite pairwise accuracy above 90%, acceptance rates can differ by as much as 43% under a single global threshold. The clean semantic-control setup is the strongest part of the paper.
summary_en.authors_note: Evaluation work from the Language Technology Lab at the University of Cambridge. Anna Korhonen is a well-known researcher in the area.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接影响你怎么看 RM/judge 数据管线：pairwise accuracy 基本不够，做多语种筛数或对齐前先补 calibration 检查；重点看 acceptance-rate gap。
recommendation.en: This should change how you trust RM/judge pipelines: pairwise accuracy is not enough; add calibration checks before multilingual filtering or alignment, and focus on the acceptance-rate gap.

institutions: Language Technology Lab, University of Cambridge

paper.title: Do You Need a Frontier Model as a Citation Verifier? Benchmarking Rubric LLMs for Deep-Research Source Attribution
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning increasingly relies on an LLM judge to score each rubric criterion, and that judge acts as the reward model during training. Before such a signal can be trusted, we need to know how capable the judge must be and how biased it is. We study this calibration question for citation quality in deep-research systems, where a search-grounded LLM must support each claim it writes with a cited source. Citation quality is a structured rubric task in which each attribution-citation pa

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“如何做更好的 citation evaluation”，而是一个更具体、也更贴近 RL 后训练的问题：当 citation rubric 被拿来当 reward signal 时，离线评测里常用的 LLM judge 到底需要多强、偏差有多大、能不能用更便宜的模型替代前沿模型。作者把问题收缩到 deep-research 场景中的 attribution-citation pair 级别判断，重点看两个必须依赖 LLM 的维度：source relevance 和 factual support。前者判断引用源是否和 claim 主题相关，后者判断该源是否真的支撑 claim。论文的核心出发点很清楚：如果 judge 的方向性偏差没有被校准，那么 RLVR 学到的就不是“更真实的引用”，而是“更迎合某个 judge 的 rubric 偏好”的行为。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响不在训练 recipe 本身，而在 pretrain ↔ post-train 接口：很多后训练工作已经把 rubric-judged reward 当成默认做法，但 reward model 的能力边界和偏差结构常常没有被单独测量。这篇工作给出的价值主要有三点。第一，它把“LLM-as-judge 是否足够可靠”从泛泛讨论落到一个结构化、可人工复核的任务上，适合作为 RLVR reward calibration 的案例。第二，它说明 judge 选择不能只看单一 F1；pass-rate drift、false positive rate、false negative rate 会直接决定训练时被强化的行为方向。第三，它给出一个偏实务的结论：在定义清楚、输入受控的 rubric 任务上，便宜模型未必明显差于 frontier model，但不同维度可能需要不同 judge。这对构建低成本、可扩展的 reward pipeline 有现实意义。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上没有提出新的 judge 架构，而是把 benchmark 和分析框架做得足够贴近真实训练使用场景。整体流程建立在已有的 source attribution evaluation pipeline 之上：先从 markdown 长文中用 AST parser 抽取 attribution-citation pairs，再对每个 pair 按 rubric 打分。作者这次补上的关键部分，是构造了一个受控、带对抗性的 long-form benchmark，并为两个 LLM-judged 维度建立 gold labels。

数据构造上，benchmark 是一篇覆盖 25 个主题域的长报告，里面故意混入 factual errors 和 misleading citations，让 judge 不能只靠表面词重合做判断。标注单元是 624 个 attribution-citation pairs，对应 1,248 个 rubric decisions。所有标签都经过人工复核，其中 378 个 hard cases 来自 judge disagreement 后再 adjudication，这一点很重要：它让 benchmark 更像是在测“judge 在边界样本上的稳定性”，而不是只测容易样本上的平均准确率。

评测对象是 8 个 off-the-shelf judges，来自 Anthropic、Google、OpenAI 三个家族。作者没有做 task-specific fine-tuning，刻意模拟实际部署时“直接拿现成模型做 judge”的情形。指标设计也比常见的 judge benchmark 更贴近 reward 使用：主指标是 F1 和 Cohen’s kappa，用来衡量与 gold 的一致性；同时额外报告 pass-rate drift、FPR、FNR，用来刻画方向性偏差。这里的关键判断是：两个 judge 可能 F1 接近，但一个偏宽松、一个偏保守，在 RL 中会导向完全不同的策略更新。论文真正有信息量的地方就在这里，而不是简单排一个 judge 榜单。

从问题设定上看，这篇工作和一般 LLM-as-judge 论文的区别在于三点。第一，它不是开放式偏好评审，而是细粒度 rubric decision，更接近 process reward model 的 step-level judgment。第二，它把 citation quality 拆成 relevance 与 support 两个不同认知负担的子任务，避免把错误混在一起。第三，它强调 retrieval harness 会影响 judge 输入分布，因此 judge 评测结果只在给定 attribution extraction 和 source presentation 方式下成立，这种系统视角比单纯比较模型分数更实用。
summary.experiments:
核心结果有两个。第一，没有单一模型在两个维度上都占优。source relevance 上，GPT-5-mini 的 F1 最好，达到 0.908，kappa 为 0.636；factual support 上，Claude Opus 4.6 最强，F1 为 0.750，kappa 为 0.701。这个结果说明 relevance 和 support 不是同一种 judge 能力：前者更像主题匹配与局部证据对齐，后者更接近细粒度事实核验与证据充分性判断。

第二，方向性偏差差异显著，而且不能被 F1 反映。论文强调，不同 judge 在 pass-rate drift、FPR、FNR 上差别很大。也就是说，有些模型更容易“放过”不充分引用，有些模型更容易“错杀”本来合格的引用。对于 RLVR，这不是次要问题：高 FPR 会奖励虚假支撑，高 FNR 会压制本来正确但表达复杂的回答。虽然给出的摘要里没有列出全部模型逐项数值，但全文的重点显然不是谁分最高，而是“相近准确率下偏差结构不同”。

数据规模方面，benchmark 含 624 个 pair、1,248 个 LLM-judged decisions，全部 human-reviewed，其中 378 个是 hard cases，包含 263 个 relevance 难例和 115 个 support 难例。这个规模不算大，但对于人工复核的 citation-level benchmark 已经足够支撑 judge calibration 分析。论文还把任务放在 adversarial long-form setting 下，这比短问答式 citation checking 更接近 deep-research agent 的真实输出分布。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三部分。第一看 Introduction，重点不是背景铺陈，而是作者如何把 citation judging 明确映射成 RLVR 中的 reward model 问题。第二看 benchmark construction 和 labeling protocol，确认 hard cases 是怎么来的、人工 adjudication 的标准是什么，因为这决定了结果可信度。第三看结果表里 F1/kappa 与 bias metrics 的并列展示，尤其是相近 F1 但不同 FPR/FNR 的模型对比，这是全文最该记住的结论。

如果时间有限，建议优先看：任务定义图、benchmark 统计表、主结果表、误差分析部分。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以抓住主要信息。更值得深挖的点有两个：一是 factual support 的定义边界是否足够稳定，是否会受 source chunking 和上下文截断影响；二是如果把 judge 放进真实 RL loop，pass-rate drift 最终会怎样改变 policy behavior，这篇工作提出了问题，但没有真正做 closed-loop training 验证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrow but operationally important question for RL with rubric-based rewards: how strong does an LLM judge need to be before citation-quality rewards become unreliable, and what kinds of bias do different judges introduce? The setting is deep-research systems that generate long-form answers with source attributions. Each attribution-citation pair is scored on two LLM-dependent dimensions: source relevance and factual support. The real target is not citation evaluation in isolation, but reward calibration. If the judge is systematically too lenient or too strict, the downstream RL loop will optimize toward that bias rather than toward faithful attribution.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly at the pretrain/post-train interface rather than in core pretraining mechanics. Many post-training pipelines now treat rubric-scored LLM judges as a default reward source, but the judge itself is often under-evaluated. This work contributes a concrete calibration study in a structured task with human-reviewed labels. Three points matter. First, it shows that judge quality can be studied on a task that is narrow enough to label carefully, yet realistic enough to matter for deployed research agents. Second, it argues that scalar agreement metrics are insufficient for reward design; pass-rate drift, false positives, and false negatives determine what behavior gets reinforced. Third, it suggests that cheaper off-the-shelf judges can be competitive on well-specified rubric tasks, though not uniformly across dimensions. That is useful for building scalable reward pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper does not introduce a new judge model. Its contribution is a benchmark and an analysis protocol designed around actual reward-model use. The evaluation pipeline follows prior source-attribution work: parse attribution-citation pairs from markdown long-form outputs using an AST-based parser, then score each pair against rubric criteria. The new piece is a controlled adversarial benchmark with gold labels for the two LLM-judged dimensions.

The benchmark is a single long-form report spanning 25 topic domains, intentionally seeded with factual errors and misleading citations. This design prevents judges from succeeding through shallow lexical overlap alone. The labeled unit is the attribution-citation pair. In total there are 624 pairs and 1,248 rubric decisions. All labels are human-reviewed, and 378 hard cases are explicitly adjudicated from judge disagreements. That matters because it shifts the benchmark toward boundary cases, where reward signals are most fragile.

The study evaluates 8 off-the-shelf judges from Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI, without task-specific fine-tuning. This is deliberate: the goal is to reflect realistic deployment, where teams often plug in a general-purpose model as a judge. Metrics are also chosen with reward use in mind. F1 and Cohen’s kappa measure agreement with gold labels, while pass-rate drift, false positive rate, and false negative rate expose directional bias. This is the central methodological point: two judges with similar F1 can induce very different RL behavior if one over-accepts weak citations and the other over-rejects valid but complex ones.

Relative to generic LLM-as-judge papers, the setup differs in three ways. It uses structured rubric decisions rather than open-ended preference judgments. It separates source relevance from factual support instead of collapsing them into one score. And it treats retrieval and source presentation as part of the evaluation context, acknowledging that judge behavior depends on the harness, not just on the model.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical result is that no single judge dominates both dimensions. On source relevance, GPT-5-mini achieves the best F1 at 0.908 with kappa 0.636. On factual support, Claude Opus 4.6 leads with F1 0.750 and kappa 0.701. This split is informative: relevance looks more like topical matching plus local evidence alignment, while factual support requires stricter evidence sufficiency and factual verification.

The second key result is that directional bias varies substantially even when scalar accuracy is similar. The paper highlights large differences in pass-rate drift, false positive rate, and false negative rate across judges. That matters directly for RLVR. A high false positive rate rewards unsupported claims; a high false negative rate suppresses correct but nuanced attributions. The benchmark therefore does more than rank judges. It shows that reward design must account for the shape of judge errors, not just average agreement.

In terms of scale, the benchmark contains 624 attribution-citation pairs and 1,248 LLM-judged decisions, all human-reviewed, with 378 hard cases including 263 relevance disputes and 115 support disputes. This is not a massive dataset, but it is substantial for citation-level human adjudication, especially in an adversarial long-form setting.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three parts. First, the introduction, specifically where the paper reframes citation judging as a reward-model calibration problem for RLVR. Second, the benchmark construction and labeling protocol, because the credibility of the results depends heavily on how hard cases were generated and adjudicated. Third, the main results tables where F1 and kappa are shown alongside bias metrics. The most important takeaway is not the leaderboard, but the mismatch between similar scalar accuracy and different error directions.

If time is limited, read the task-definition figure, benchmark statistics, main comparison table, and the error-analysis section. Around 20 to 30 minutes should be enough to extract the main message. The deeper questions worth following up are whether factual-support labels remain stable under different source chunking or context windows, and how these judge biases would actually alter policy behavior inside a closed-loop RL training run.

recommendation.zh: 做 RL judge 或 verifier 的人该看；结论未必能外推到所有 rubric，但“便宜 judge 在 relevance 上够用、support 上未必”这个分解很实用。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you build RL judges or verifiers; the result may not generalize to every rubric, but the split—cheap judges are often enough for relevance, not necessarily for factual support—is operationally useful.

paper.title: Hallucination Self-Play: Bootstrapping Reinforced Detector via Evolved Generator
paper.abstract: Identifying faithfulness hallucinations in LLM-generated outputs remains challenging due to the scarcity of high-quality annotated data. Recent work relies on advanced LLMs to synthesize training data, including rationales, labels, and hallucinated claims. However, these methods treat the generator as a static component, limiting iterative improvement of the detector. To address this limitation, we introduce Hallucination Self-Play (HSP), a novel framework that enables the detector to bootstrap

summary.core_problem: 解决高质量 hallucination 检测数据稀缺的问题，尤其是如何持续生成更难、更贴近真实失真模式的训练样本来提升 detector。
summary.importance: 这是后训练数据合成与自博弈框架工作。价值在于把 detector 和 generator 放进闭环，用 RLAIF 驱动“对抗式”数据难度提升。对 reward model、judge、合成数据课程设计有一定启发，但离 pretrain 主线较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Hallucination Self-Play（HSP）。从同一 base model 初始化 detector 和 generator：先用人工标注数据微调 detector，再把 detector 当 reward model，通过 RLAIF 训练 generator 生成更难识别的 hallucinated responses；随后用这些样本继续优化 detector，形成迭代自举。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模和数据量。核心实验应围绕 detector 在 faithfulness hallucination 检测上的提升、生成样本难度演化、与静态生成器合成数据方案的比较。需要重点看是否存在 reward hacking、分布塌缩，以及 detector 是否只学到生成器特定伪迹。
summary.authors_note: Simon Fraser University、University of Illinois at Chicago。Angel X. Chang 在多模态与语言方向较知名，但这篇更偏 hallucination 检测与后训练数据闭环。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the scarcity of high-quality hallucination-detection data, especially how to keep generating harder and more realistic failure cases to improve a detector.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training data-synthesis and self-play paper. Its value is the closed loop between detector and generator, using RLAIF to increase data difficulty over time. It is relevant to reward models, judges, and synthetic-data curricula, though still peripheral to core pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Hallucination Self-Play (HSP). A detector and a generator are initialized from the same base model: the detector is first fine-tuned on human-labeled data, then used as a reward model to train the generator with RLAIF so it produces harder hallucinated responses; those synthetic examples are then used to further improve the detector.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model or data scale. The key experiments should test detector gains on faithfulness hallucination detection, the evolution of synthetic-example difficulty, and comparisons against static-generator data synthesis. The main thing to inspect is whether the loop reward-hacks itself or overfits to generator-specific artifacts.
summary_en.authors_note: Simon Fraser University and the University of Illinois at Chicago. Angel X. Chang is a recognizable name in multimodal/language research, but this paper is mainly about hallucination detection and post-training data loops.

recommendation.zh: 思路不新到改 prior，但 detector-generator 闭环值得借给 judge/RM 数据合成；先查它有没有学到生成器伪迹，没过这关就别信分数。
recommendation.en: This does not really change priors, but the detector-generator loop is worth borrowing for judge/RM data synthesis; first check whether it just learns generator artifacts before trusting the gains.

paper.title: Best-of-Better-$N$: Generating Pre-Aligned Responses with In-Context Learning
paper.abstract: Inference-time alignment methods, such as Best-of-$N$, offer a flexible alternative to training-based alignment by using reward models to select high-quality responses generated by a reference LLM. However, the efficacy of these methods is inherently limited by the response quality: if the reference LLM assigns negligible probability to high-reward responses, no selection strategy will succeed in finding aligned outputs. In this work, we propose Best-of-Better-$N$ (BoBN), an in context learning-

summary.core_problem: 推理时对齐（ITA）方法如Best-of-N的效果受限于参考LLM的响应分布覆盖能力——如果参考模型生成高奖励响应的概率极低，再好的选择策略也无法得到对齐输出，这是推理时对齐的根本性瓶颈（即「高质量响应覆盖率」假设不成立）。
summary.importance: 展示了上下文学习可以在不修改模型权重的情况下偏移输出分布，这种无权重对齐的思路为理解预训练模型的泛化能力、探索低成本对齐路径提供了参考；检索+重写的范式也可用于提升预训练合成数据的质量。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Best-of-Better-N（BoBN）框架，核心是用上下文学习提升参考LLM对高奖励响应的覆盖率：首先检索与输入查询和任务相关的高奖励示例，然后增加一步重样式化（restyling），由参考LLM将检索到的响应改写为符合目标任务格式和风格的形式，再将处理后的示例作为上下文输入，让参考模型的输出分布向高奖励区域偏移，之后再执行Best-of-N选择。论文还从理论上分析了检索质量对覆盖率和下游性能的控制关系。
summary.experiments: 在安全对齐（StrongReject基准）和数学推理任务上测试，覆盖多个不同规模的参考LLM：BoBN在N=1（单生成）和N>1（Best-of-N选择）的设置下均能提升基准性能，验证了预对齐的响应本身质量更高，且与Best-of-N选择有叠加效应；实验同时验证了覆盖率的提升与性能提升趋势一致。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，重点关注引言中对推理时对齐两个基本假设的拆解（覆盖率假设、选择准确性假设），以及BoBN的重样式化步骤设计；理论分析部分可按需阅读，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Inference-time alignment (ITA) methods such as Best-of-N are fundamentally limited by the response distribution coverage of the reference LLM. If the reference model assigns negligible probability to high-reward responses, no selection strategy can produce aligned outputs — this is the core bottleneck of ITA when the "high-quality response coverage" assumption fails.
summary_en.importance: The work demonstrates that in-context learning can shift output distribution without modifying model weights, a weight-free alignment paradigm that informs research on pretrained model generalization and low-cost alignment pathways. The retrieve-plus-restyle pipeline can also be applied to improve the quality of synthetic pretraining data.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Best-of-Better-N (BoBN) framework improves the reference LLM's coverage of high-reward responses via in-context learning. It first retrieves high-reward examples relevant to the input query and task, then adds a restyling step where the reference LLM rewrites the retrieved responses to match the target task's format and style. The processed examples are used as in-context context to shift the reference model's output distribution toward the high-reward region, before Best-of-N selection is applied. The paper also theoretically analyzes how retrieval quality controls coverage and downstream task performance.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on safety alignment (StrongReject benchmark) and mathematical reasoning tasks across multiple reference LLMs of different sizes, BoBN improves benchmark performance under both N=1 (single generation) and N>1 (Best-of-N selection) settings. This confirms that pre-aligned BoBN responses have higher individual quality, and the effect compounds with Best-of-N selection. Empirical coverage improvements are shown to align with performance gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level reading. Focus on the decomposition of two fundamental ITA assumptions (coverage assumption, selection accuracy assumption) in the introduction, and the design of BoBN's restyling step. The theoretical analysis section can be read optionally. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法和消融：它把 BoN 的瓶颈从 selection 改成 proposal distribution，若预算对齐干净可影响对齐采样策略。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and ablations: it reframes BoN’s bottleneck as the proposal distribution, which matters if the sampling-budget comparison is clean.

paper.title: Qwen-Image-2.0-RL Technical Report
paper.abstract: We present Qwen-Image-2.0-RL, a post-training pipeline that applies reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) and on-policy distillation (OPD) to improve both the visual quality and instruction-following capability of the Qwen-Image-2.0 diffusion model. To provide reliable reward signals, we construct task-specific composite reward models by fine-tuning vision-language models with a pointwise scoring paradigm and chain-of-thought reasoning. For text-to-image generation, the reward models

summary.core_problem: 解决扩散生成模型（Qwen-Image-2.0）的视觉质量与指令跟随能力难以兼顾，RLHF落地缺乏可靠奖励信号与稳定训练策略的问题。
summary.importance: 顶级机构的工业级技术报告，贡献类型包括系统创新（可扩展的扩散模型RLHF训练框架）、数据/奖励模型设计（多维度复合奖励模型、prompt筛选策略），为生成式大模型的后训练对齐提供落地参考。
summary.technical_approach: 1）构建任务特异性复合奖励模型：用带点式打分与CoT推理的VLM微调，覆盖文本生成的对齐/美学/人脸保真、图像编辑的指令跟随/人脸保存维度；2）提出基于GRPO的可扩展RL训练框架，结合混合CFG策略保留预训练知识、组内奖励范围筛选做prompt提纯、逐类别奖励权重校准；3）用任务感知参数融合合并各任务专精的RL checkpoint。
summary.experiments: 基于Qwen-Image-2.0扩散基座做训练，覆盖文本到图像、图像编辑两类任务，主观与客观评测均显著优于基线RLHF方案与原生基座。
summary.authors_note: 阿里巴巴Qwen（通义千问）团队，核心负责多模态生成大模型的研发与迭代。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the trade-off between visual quality and instruction following in diffusion generative models (Qwen-Image-2.0), and the lack of reliable reward signals and stable training recipes for diffusion RLHF deployment.
summary_en.importance: Industrial-grade technical report from a top-tier institution; contributions include system innovation (scalable diffusion RLHF training framework), reward/data design (multi-dimensional composite reward models, prompt curation strategy), providing deployment references for post-training alignment of generative foundation models.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Builds task-specific composite reward models by fine-tuning VLMs with pointwise scoring and CoT reasoning, covering alignment/aesthetics/portrait fidelity for T2I, and instruction following/face identity preservation for editing; 2) Proposes a scalable GRPO-based RL training framework with hybrid CFG to preserve pretrained knowledge, intra-group reward range filtering for prompt curation, and per-category reward weight calibration; 3) Merges task-specialized RL checkpoints via task-aware parameter fusion.
summary_en.experiments: Trained on Qwen-Image-2.0 diffusion backbone, covering text-to-image and image editing tasks; both subjective and objective evaluations significantly outperform baseline RLHF methods and the original foundation model.
summary_en.authors_note: Qwen team of Alibaba Group, responsible for R&D and iteration of multimodal generative foundation models.

recommendation.zh: 扩散模型RLHF的工业级落地方案，混合CFG保留预训练知识、组内奖励筛选的设计可直接复用至多模态生成的后训练ablation。
recommendation.en: Industrial-grade RLHF deployment pipeline for diffusion models; hybrid CFG for pretrained knowledge preservation and intra-group reward filtering are directly reusable for multimodal generative post-training ablations.

paper.title: PEBS: Per-rater Empirical-Bayes Shrinkage for RLHF Reward-Model Calibration
