summary.core_problem: 现有RLHF奖励模型采用全局仿射校准，忽略不同标注者的评分尺度偏移和斜率差异，导致校准结果与单个标注者不匹配
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出无需重训奖励模型的闭式后处理校准方案，解决RLHF中标注者异质性导致的RM校准偏差问题
summary.technical_approach: 提出PEBS（Per-rater Empirical-Bayes Shrinkage）：对每个标注者的留出评分拟合独立仿射校准器，采用Morris-James-Stein经验贝叶斯方法向总体均值做闭式收缩，全程不改动基础奖励模型参数
summary.experiments: 在PRISM偏好数据集上，比全局 pooled 基线降低8.58%的用户内留出RMSE；在PluriHarms危害评分数据集（Qwen-2.5 base，同分布）上，RMSE降低9.66%

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RLHF reward models use a global affine calibrator across annotators, ignoring systematic differences in rater-specific rating scale offsets and slopes, resulting in calibration that does not match individual annotators
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a closed-form post-hoc calibration scheme without retraining the reward model, addressing RM calibration bias caused by annotator heterogeneity in RLHF
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces PEBS (Per-rater Empirical-Bayes Shrinkage): fits per-rater affine calibrators on held-out ratings from each annotator, then applies closed-form Morris-James-Stein empirical Bayes shrinkage toward the population mean, with no changes to the base reward model parameters
summary_en.experiments: Reduces within-user held-out RMSE by 8.58% over the pooled baseline on PRISM; achieves 9.66% RMSE reduction on PluriHarms harm ratings (Qwen-2.5 base, in-family) over the same baseline

recommendation.zh: RM校准的轻量实用改进，无需重训模型，做RLHF的同学可直接复用§3的闭式收缩公式验证内部标注偏差
recommendation.en: A lightweight practical improvement for RM calibration with no retraining required; RLHF practitioners can directly reuse the closed-form shrinkage formula in §3 to validate internal annotator bias

paper.title: Discretizing Reward Models
paper.abstract: Despite their widespread use, the role of reward models in shaping reinforcement learning is poorly understood. Reward models offer a tempting promise: they automatically estimate response quality in the absence of verifiers or human judges. Unlike "verifiable rewards" which typically produce binary scores, reward models typically produce continuous scores, allowing them to be sensitive to fine-grained differences in responses. However, we show this apparent strength is a serious weakness: many

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的不是“奖励模型准不准”这个老问题，而是更细的一层：连续值 reward model 在强化学习里会不会把本来同样好的回答硬排出高低。作者把这个现象定义为 oversensitivity。问题的关键在于，很多 prompt 并不存在唯一最优回答，而是有多个效用等价的 response class。若 RM 在这些等价回答之间给出稳定且可学习的分数差，RL 就会把这种差异当成真实优化信号，进而放大风格偏好、标注偶然性和训练噪声，而不是提升真实任务效用。论文因此重新定义了 RM 的好坏标准：不能只看 pairwise accuracy 或偏好一致率，还要看它对等价回答是否“足够不敏感”。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-train 接口的意义很直接。过去很多工作默认 reward model 越细粒度越好，连续分数越丰富越能提供学习信号；这篇文章指出，连续性本身可能是问题来源。它把“奖励模型为什么在 benchmark 上看着很准，但拿去做 RL 教出来的 policy 不稳定甚至变差”这件事讲清楚了一部分。贡献主要有三层。第一，提出 oversensitivity / specificity 这一套更贴近 RL 使用场景的评价视角，而不是只看 accuracy。第二，给出理论说明：即便一个看似完美、排序能力很强的 RM，也可能因为在等价响应之间过度区分而成为坏老师。第三，给出一个很实用的修正方向：把连续 reward 离散化成簇，让 RL 优化“组间差异”而不是“组内噪声”。这对 RLHF、RLAIF、以及用 LM-as-a-judge 直接做在线 RL 的路线都有现实影响。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上分成理论和算法两部分。理论部分先把真实效用 u(x,y) 建模为整数值，表示一个 prompt 下有限个可感知的效用等级，也就是多个等价类。对应地，一个好的 RM 需要同时满足两件事：一是能区分不同效用等级，二是不要在同一效用等级内部制造无意义差异。作者用 discriminative ability 和 specificity 来刻画这两个方向，并强调二者存在张力：单纯追求 accuracy 往往会鼓励模型在所有样本上强行排序，单纯追求高方差也会把无关差异放大。论文的核心主张是，合适的 discretization 可以在保留跨等级区分能力的同时，压掉等级内部的伪差异。

算法部分并不是简单做固定阈值分桶，而是做 uncertainty-aware clustering。具体做法是：对 reward model 开启 Monte Carlo dropout，多次前向得到同一 response 的 reward 分布，用预测方差估计 RM 在该点附近的不确定性。然后基于 reward 均值和不确定性，把一组候选回答聚成若干簇；簇内视为效用近似等价，RL 时不再利用簇内细粒度分差。直观上，这相当于把“连续打分器”改造成“带置信区间的等级判别器”。与常见做法相比，区别有三点。第一，它不是重新训练 RM，而是在推理侧后处理 reward。第二，它不是把 reward 简单二值化，而是自适应地保留必要的层级结构。第三，它关心的是 RL 可用性，而不是静态偏好预测分数。

从全文表述看，作者还讨论了为什么“增大 reward variance”不是正确目标。真正有用的是 inter-class variance，不是 intra-class variance。离散化的作用，就是尽量把后者折叠掉。这个视角和很多 reward shaping 直觉不同，也比“校准 reward scale”更进一步，因为问题不只是尺度，而是排序结构本身。
summary.experiments:
实验分三块，设计得比较完整。第一块是在 RewardBench 2 的 Ties 子集上直接测 oversensitivity。这个子集专门包含应当判为平手的样本，适合看 RM 是否会对等价回答乱排高低。作者在多种流行 RM 上做离散化后，结论比较一致：specificity 明显改善，discriminative ability 只付出温和代价，因此两者的综合指标更好。这里最重要的不是单个模型涨了多少，而是趋势稳定，说明 oversensitivity 不是个别 RM 的偶发现象。

第二块是一个可控模拟环境。作者构造了 primary reward 与 spurious stylistic reward 的混合目标，前者代表真实任务效用，如 instruction following；后者代表风格、措辞、长度等容易被 RM 学进去但未必该被优化的因素。直接优化原始连续 reward 时，policy 会明显朝风格维度过拟合，牺牲 primary reward；离散化后，这种 stylistic overoptimization 被显著抑制，主任务表现保持更好。这个实验很关键，因为它把 oversensitivity 从“评测现象”推进到“会伤害 RL 训练结果”的因果链条。

第三块是更接近真实使用场景的多任务 RL。作者在无标注 prompt 上训练 policy，并在 IFEval、GSM8K、MATH 上比较原始 RM 与离散化 RM。结论是：离散化版本从不显著差于原始 reward，而且经常更好。摘要里没有给出全部数字，正文表述重点也不是追求某个 benchmark 的极限分数，而是强调稳健性：当 reward model 可能混入风格偏差或 tie-breaking 噪声时，离散化能减少坏梯度。若精读实验部分，建议重点看不同任务上的方差、显著性和是否存在“原始 RM 提升某一项但整体不稳”的情况。

从实验结构判断，作者想证明三件事：能测到 oversensitivity；oversensitivity 会被 policy 学走；简单离散化足以缓解。这个证据链是完整的。局限也存在：离散化依赖候选回答集合与聚类阈值估计，若候选分布很窄或 RM dropout 不稳定，效果可能受影响；另外，论文更像是在 RL teacher 侧做修正，还没有触及如何从训练数据和目标函数层面直接学出低-oversensitivity 的 RM。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1、Figure 2，把作者区分的三件事先立住：accuracy、variance、oversensitivity。很多后文细节都围绕这三个概念展开。然后精读 Problem Formulation，尤其是真实效用被建模为有限整数等级这一设定。这个假设不是装饰，它决定了为什么“离散化”在理论上是合理的，而不是拍脑袋做分桶。

理论部分重点看作者如何定义 discriminative ability 与 specificity，以及证明“看似完美的连续 RM 仍可能是坏老师”的例子。这里值得深挖的是：他们批评的不是 reward model 的噪声大小，而是噪声的结构。若你做 RLHF/RLAIF，这一段会直接影响你如何设计 RM 评测集。

方法部分重点看 Monte Carlo dropout 如何被用来估计 predictive variance，以及 clustering / thresholding 的具体流程。要特别留意它为什么选择 uncertainty-aware discretization，而不是固定温度缩放、分位数截断或简单二值化。若你关心工程落地，这部分决定了方法能否作为现有 RM 的后处理模块接入。

实验部分建议按顺序看：先 Ties 子集，再模拟环境，再真实多任务 RL。前两者负责建立机制，最后一组负责说明现实收益。最值得细看的图表通常是：离散化前后 specificity 与 discriminative ability 的变化、primary vs stylistic reward 的 trade-off、以及不同任务上原始 RM 与离散化 RM 的稳定性比较。

如果时间有限，60-90 分钟可以抓住主线；若要真正吸收，建议连附录里的理论细节和实验设置一起看，因为这篇文章的价值主要在概念澄清和评价框架，而不只是一个小技巧。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a more precise question than standard reward-model evaluation: not whether a reward model is accurate on preference pairs, but whether it assigns learnable score differences to responses that are actually equally good. The authors call this oversensitivity. This matters because many prompts admit multiple utility-equivalent answers. If a continuous reward model imposes a strict ordering within that equivalence set, RL will optimize those arbitrary differences as if they were real utility. The result is policy drift toward stylistic artifacts, annotation indeterminacy, and reward-model quirks rather than better task performance.
summary_en.importance: This is important for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface because it explains part of a familiar failure mode: reward models can look strong on static benchmarks yet behave as poor teachers during RL. The paper contributes a more RL-relevant lens for reward-model quality. Pairwise accuracy is not enough; one also needs low sensitivity within equal-utility regions. The contribution is not a new large-scale RM, but a reframing of what makes an RM usable for optimization. That has direct implications for RLHF, RLAIF, and LM-as-a-judge pipelines, especially in settings where rewards are continuous and unverifiable. The practical message is sharp: richer reward granularity is not automatically better if the extra variance comes from the wrong place.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has a theoretical layer and a practical layer. The theoretical setup models true utility u(x, y) as an integer-valued function with a finite number of perceptible utility levels for each prompt. That formalizes the idea that many responses belong to the same utility class. Under this view, a good reward model must do two things at once: separate different utility classes and avoid inventing distinctions within the same class. The paper uses discriminative ability for the former and specificity for the latter. The central claim is that these objectives need not be traded off blindly; a suitable discretization of reward scores can preserve useful between-class variation while suppressing harmful within-class variation.

The practical method is uncertainty-aware reward discretization. Instead of retraining the reward model, the authors estimate predictive uncertainty with Monte Carlo dropout by running the RM multiple times and measuring the variance of the predicted reward. They then cluster candidate responses using both reward means and uncertainty, treating responses within a cluster as approximately utility-equivalent. RL no longer optimizes fine-grained score gaps inside those clusters. In effect, the method converts a continuous scorer into a confidence-aware ordinal teacher.

This differs from common alternatives in several ways. It is not simple reward binning with fixed thresholds, not temperature scaling, and not binary verification. It preserves some hierarchy when the model is confident that differences are meaningful, while collapsing distinctions when the score differences are likely to reflect uncertainty or arbitrary tie-breaking. A key conceptual point in the paper is that reward variance is only useful when it aligns with true utility differences. Inter-class variance helps learning; intra-class variance hurts it.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are organized to establish a full causal story. First, the authors evaluate oversensitivity directly on the Ties subset of RewardBench 2, where responses should be treated as ties. Across several popular reward models, discretization consistently improves specificity while only modestly reducing discriminative ability, improving their combined quality. The important result here is the consistency across models rather than a single headline number.

Second, they build a controlled environment with a mixture of a primary reward and a spurious stylistic reward. The primary component represents actual task utility such as instruction following; the secondary component captures style-related features that a reward model may latch onto. Optimizing the raw continuous reward leads to strong stylistic overoptimization and degraded primary-task performance. Discretization suppresses that failure mode and preserves the primary objective much better. This is the key mechanism experiment because it shows that oversensitivity is not just a benchmark artifact; it becomes a learnable signal that policy optimization exploits.

Third, they run a more realistic multitask RL setup on unlabeled prompts and evaluate on IFEval, GSM8K, and MATH. The discretized reward models are never significantly worse than the raw reward models and are often better. The emphasis is on robustness rather than chasing a single best benchmark score. The paper argues that when reward models contain stylistic bias or tie-breaking noise, discretization reduces harmful gradients without sacrificing useful supervision.

The experimental story is strong because it covers measurement, mechanism, and downstream impact. The main limitation is that the method still depends on the candidate-response set and on uncertainty estimates from dropout. It is a teacher-side correction rather than a solution to training low-oversensitivity reward models from first principles.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the early figures, especially the examples that separate accuracy, variance, and oversensitivity. Those distinctions carry the whole paper. Then read the problem formulation carefully. The assumption that true utility is discrete and finite is not cosmetic; it is what makes discretization theoretically natural rather than an ad hoc heuristic.

In the theory section, focus on how discriminative ability and specificity are defined, and on the constructions showing that an apparently excellent continuous reward model can still be a bad RL teacher. The key insight is structural: the issue is not just reward noise magnitude, but where the variance lives.

In the method section, pay attention to how Monte Carlo dropout is used to estimate predictive variance and how clustering thresholds are chosen. The useful question to keep in mind is why this approach is preferable to simpler fixes such as score clipping, fixed binning, or binary conversion.

For experiments, read them in order: RewardBench Ties for direct oversensitivity measurement, the synthetic mixed-reward setup for mechanism, and the multitask RL results for practical relevance. The most informative plots are the ones showing the trade-off between specificity and discriminative ability, the primary-versus-stylistic reward dynamics, and the stability comparison between raw and discretized rewards.

If time is limited, an hour is enough to get the main idea. If the goal is to reuse the ideas in RLHF or judge-model work, the appendices are worth reading because the value of the paper lies more in the evaluation framework and conceptual cleanup than in the implementation alone.

recommendation.zh: 连续RM过敏感性结论直接改变对齐实验设计，§3理论和§4离散化方法应立刻加入内部消融实验
recommendation.en: The oversensitivity finding of continuous RMs directly changes alignment experiment design, add Section 3 theory and Section 4 discretization to internal ablations immediately.

paper.title: The Quality-Utility Paradox: Why High-Reward Data Impairs Small Model Mathematical Reasoning
paper.abstract: Knowledge distillation from powerful reasoning models is widely used to improve Small Language Models (SLMs) on mathematical reasoning, often assuming that traces with higher reward model scores provide more useful supervision. We identify a counterintuitive \textbf{Quality-Utility Paradox} in mathematical reasoning distillation. Data refined or synthesized by a stronger Oracle obtains higher perceived quality according to reward models, yet consistently underperforms traces generated by the SLM

summary.core_problem: 解决小模型数学推理蒸馏中的一个反常现象：奖励模型评分更高、看起来更“优质”的推理轨迹，为什么反而让学生模型学得更差。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值不在新蒸馏框架本身，而在于指出了一个会直接影响合成推理数据和后训练配方的失配机制：高 reward 不等于高 utility。对做 SFT/RL 数据构造、teacher-student distillation、以及 pretrain↔post-train 接口的人都有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Quality-Utility Paradox：强 Oracle 对轨迹做 refinement 或 synthesis 后，虽然 reward model 评分更高，但会把样本分布推离学生模型原生 reasoning style，导致 adaptation cost 上升，抵消逻辑修复带来的收益。为验证这一机制，提出 Style-Aligned Refinement，在保留学生模型原生轨迹风格的前提下进行逻辑修复，尽量减少 distributional drift。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen2.5、LLaMA-3、DeepSeek 等多个模型家族的小模型数学推理蒸馏设置；比较对象包括 Oracle refined/synthesized traces 与学生模型自生成后经 rejection sampling 选出的轨迹。摘要结论是：前者 reward 更高但训练后效果更差，而 style-aligned refinement 能恢复部分收益。摘要未给出具体参数量、数据量和提升幅度，但 setup 横跨多个家族，说明现象不是单一模型偶然性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a counterintuitive issue in small-model math reasoning distillation: why traces with higher reward-model scores can be less useful for training the student.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is not a new distillation pipeline per se, but a concrete failure mode for synthetic reasoning data and post-training recipes: high reward does not imply high utility. This matters directly for SFT/RL data construction, teacher-student distillation, and the pretrain-to-post-train interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formulate the Quality-Utility Paradox: Oracle refinement or synthesis improves apparent trace quality under reward models, but also induces distributional drift away from the student's native reasoning style, increasing adaptation cost and offsetting the benefit of better logic. To test this mechanism, they propose Style-Aligned Refinement, which repairs logic while preserving the student's native trajectory style.
summary_en.experiments: The study spans math reasoning distillation setups across Qwen2.5, LLaMA-3, and DeepSeek model families. It compares Oracle-refined/synthesized traces against traces generated by the student itself and selected via rejection sampling. The abstract claims the former score higher under reward models yet train worse, while style-aligned refinement recovers part of the loss. Exact model sizes, data scale, and gains are not given in the abstract, but the multi-family setup suggests the effect is not a one-off artifact.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接改你对“高分合成 CoT 就该拿来蒸馏”的 prior；先看机制分析和 ablation，若 setup 干净，内部数据筛选准则要立刻加一条 style-distance。
recommendation.en: This should update the prior that high-reward synthetic CoT is automatically good distillation data; read the mechanism and ablations first, and add a style-distance filter if the setup is clean.

paper.title: Understanding helpfulness and harmless tension in reward models
paper.abstract: Reward models are a key component of reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), aligning language models toward both helpful and harmless behaviour. However, the internal mechanisms underlying these objectives and their conflicts remain poorly understood. We study alignment tension in reward models trained under helpfulness-only, harmlessness-only, and mixed-objective settings. We find that mixed-objective models often underperform single-objective models, indicating interference between

summary.core_problem: RLHF奖励模型中有用性与无害性两个对齐目标存在已知冲突，但这种冲突的内部神经机制一直缺乏清晰解释。
summary.importance: 机制分析贡献，从神经元层面定位了奖励模型目标干扰的来源，为多目标对齐的奖励模型设计提供实证依据。
summary.technical_approach: 分别训练单目标（仅有用性、仅无害性）和混合目标奖励模型，通过激活归因识别各目标对应的神经元，用定向消融验证神经元的因果作用，量化分析共享神经元的分布和行为影响。
summary.experiments: 混合目标奖励模型表现弱于单目标模型，存在明确的跨目标干扰；目标专属神经元会提升对应目标表现但常损伤另一目标；占比可观的共享神经元对模型输出有不成比例的高影响力，是对齐张力的核心来源。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自哥本哈根大学，聚焦LLM对齐与机制可解释性研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The neural mechanisms underlying the well-documented tension between helpfulness and harmlessness objectives in RLHF reward models remain poorly characterized.
summary_en.importance: A mechanistic analysis that identifies neuron-level sources of cross-objective interference in reward models, providing empirical grounding for multi-objective alignment design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors train reward models in three settings (helpfulness-only, harmlessness-only, mixed objective), use activation attribution to map neurons to each objective, run targeted ablations to measure causal effects, and characterize the functional role of neurons shared across objectives.
summary_en.experiments: Mixed-objective reward models underperform single-objective models due to cross-objective interference. Objective-specific neurons causally improve their target objective while often hurting the other; a substantial subset of shared neurons exerts disproportionate output influence and is the primary driver of alignment tension.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from the University of Copenhagen, researching LLM alignment and mechanistic interpretability.

recommendation.zh: 神经元级的RM目标冲突分析比较扎实，重点看消融结果和共享神经元统计即可，对多目标对齐loss设计有参考。
recommendation.en: The neuron-level ablation analysis of reward model tradeoffs is methodologically solid; focus on the shared neuron statistics as reference for multi-objective alignment design.

paper.title: Plan-and-Verify Video Reward Reasoning with Spatio-Temporal Scene Graph Grounding
paper.abstract: Reward models for text-to-video (T2V) generation guide post-training but often fail at fine-grained semantic alignment. We trace this to two structural weaknesses in existing reasoning-based reward models: they do not systematically verify every condition described in the prompt, and the visual evidence supporting each judgment remains implicit in their free-form reasoning. We propose SG-PVR, a video reward model that addresses these limitations through plan-and-verify reasoning grounded in spat

summary.core_problem: 文本生成视频的奖励模型存在两个结构性缺陷：未逐条验证提示词所有条件，且判断依据的视觉证据隐式存在于自由推理中，导致细粒度语义对齐差。
summary.importance: 方法创新，将结构化场景图引入奖励模型的推理过程，属于多模态生成后训练的对齐方法研究。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SG-PVR视频奖励模型：先用规划模块将提示词分解为原子断言，再从视频中提取包含实体、属性与时序关系的时空场景图作为持久结构化参考，逐条断言结合视频与场景图进行显式验证。
summary.experiments: 在文本到视频的语义对齐评测上取得强性能，相比无结构化 grounding 的推理式奖励模型在细粒度条件满足率上有明显提升。

summary_en.core_problem: Text-to-video reward models suffer two structural flaws: they do not systematically verify every prompt condition, and visual evidence for judgments remains implicit in free-form reasoning, hurting fine-grained semantic alignment.
summary_en.importance: A methodological contribution that injects structured scene graphs into reward model reasoning, belonging to multimodal generation alignment and post-training research.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes SG-PVR: a plan module first decomposes the prompt into atomic claims; a spatio-temporal scene graph encoding entities, attributes, and temporally-grounded relations is extracted from the video as a persistent structured reference; each claim is explicitly verified against both the video and the scene graph.
summary_en.experiments: Achieves strong semantic alignment performance on T2V benchmarks, with measurable gains in fine-grained prompt condition satisfaction over reasoning-based reward models without structured grounding.

recommendation.zh: 多模态奖励模型的结构化grounding思路，对设计RLHF/RLVR的verifier有弱参考，看方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: The structured grounding idea for multimodal reward models offers weak reference for RLHF/RLVR verifier design; read the method section only.

paper.title: Representation-Aware Advantage Estimation: Your Reward Model Provides More Than A Scalar Output
paper.abstract: Current reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) methods primarily rely on scalar rewards from a trained reward model (RM). While effective, scalar rewards are often noisy and fail to capture fine-grained preference differences, whereas RM hidden states encode richer semantic and preference information. We introduce the representation-aware advantage estimation, which leverages RM hidden states and models them as auxiliary signals for better advantage estimation. Specifically, we propos

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是 RLHF 中只使用 reward model 的标量输出估计 advantage，容易丢掉偏好表示里的细粒度信息，并放大奖励噪声。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响有限，但对 post-train 与 pretrain 接口有启发。它提示 reward model 的隐藏状态不只是中间产物，还可以作为训练信号质量控制的一部分。对于用 RL 做推理、指令跟随或偏好对齐的流程，这类方法可能降低 advantage 方差，让同一组采样回答之间的更新方向更平滑。它不是新的基座训练范式，价值主要在 RLHF 优化细节。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 GraphAE。给定同一个 prompt 下采样得到的一组 responses，先取 reward model 在 reward head 前的隐藏表示，把每个 response 作为图节点。节点之间用表示相似度建边，文中使用 Gaussian kernel 得到全连接权重。然后求解一个图正则化目标：一方面 refined reward/advantage 要贴近原始标量 reward，另一方面相似节点的估计值要保持平滑。这个目标有闭式解，形式上相当于用图 Laplacian 对原始 reward 做结构化平滑。得到的 refined signal 可以替换 GRPO、GSPO、RLOO 等 group-based RL 算法中的原始 advantage 估计。核心取舍是：不重新训练 reward model，也不改变 policy loss，只在 advantage 构造阶段引入表示空间的局部结构。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Arena-Hard-v0.1、AlpacaEval 2.0 和 MT-Bench，并在不同 RL 算法和 backbone 上测试。论文报告 GraphAE 相比强基线在 Arena-Hard 上最高提升 +6.3，在 AlpacaEval 2.0 上最高提升 +8.27，在 MT-Bench 上最高提升 +0.22。额外分析显示，GraphAE 能降低组内 reward 方差，加快收敛，对超参数不太敏感，计算开销主要来自组内表示相似度和一个小规模闭式求解。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读方法部分和实验主表，预计 30 到 45 分钟。重点看图正则化目标、闭式解、与 GRPO/GSPO/RLOO 的接口，以及方差和收敛曲线。若只关心基座预训练，可以跳过大部分 benchmark 描述，保留一个观察：reward model 的 representation 可作为比标量 reward 更稳定的训练信号来源。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a narrow but practical RLHF issue: scalar rewards from a reward model can be noisy and under-informative, while the reward model’s hidden representations contain finer preference-related structure that is ignored by standard advantage estimators.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly relevant to post-training optimization rather than base pretraining. Its useful signal for foundation-model training is that reward quality should not be reduced to a single scalar too early. Hidden representations from the reward model can regularize policy updates and reduce within-group variance. This matters for RL pipelines used after pretraining, especially when multiple sampled responses have similar scalar scores but differ semantically.
summary_en.technical_approach: GraphAE constructs a graph over responses sampled for the same prompt. Each node is a response, represented by the reward model hidden state before the final reward head. Edge weights are computed from pairwise representation similarity, using a Gaussian kernel. The refined advantage is obtained by solving a graph-regularized objective that keeps estimates close to the original scalar rewards while enforcing smoothness over similar responses. The solution is closed-form and can be inserted into group-based RL methods such as GRPO, GSPO, and RLOO by replacing the original advantage estimator. The method leaves the reward model and policy objective mostly unchanged; the modification is localized to advantage construction.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses Arena-Hard-v0.1, AlpacaEval 2.0, and MT-Bench. Reported gains reach +6.3 on Arena-Hard, +8.27 on AlpacaEval 2.0, and +0.22 on MT-Bench across different RL algorithms and model backbones. The paper also reports reduced within-group reward variance, faster convergence, robustness to hyperparameters, and limited extra computation because the graph is built only within each sampled group.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim of 30 to 45 minutes is enough. Focus on the graph-regularized objective, its closed-form solution, and the integration points with GRPO-style training. The most relevant plots are the variance and convergence analyses. Readers focused on base-model research can treat the benchmark results as secondary and keep the main idea: reward-model representations can serve as a denoising prior for RL training signals.

recommendation.zh: 读 §方法和 advantage ablation 就够；方向对，但 RM hidden state 是否只是 reward smoothing 需要看实验干净程度。
recommendation.en: Read the method and advantage ablations; the idea is plausible, but check whether RM hidden states are just doing reward smoothing.

paper.title: A Unifying Lens on Reward Uncertainty in RLHF
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) is bottlenecked by \emph{reward hacking}, where the policy exploits errors in a proxy reward model (RM) and produces high RM scores without genuine quality gains. A natural mitigation is \emph{pessimism}: penalizing rewards in regions where the RM is uncertain. However, standard scalar RMs provide no principled notion of uncertainty. We argue that the right object is a \emph{distributional} reward model $p(r\mid x,y)$. Under either a Bayesian inf

summary.core_problem: 解决 RLHF 中 reward hacking 的一个核心根源：标量奖励模型无法表达不确定性，导致策略会系统性利用奖励模型误差。
summary.importance: 这是一篇偏理论统一的后训练工作。贡献不在于提出一个全新 RLHF 算法，而在于把“悲观奖励”这条线用统一的分布式奖励模型视角讲清楚，并把已有 ensemble 聚合规则放进同一个闭式公式里，便于判断各方法到底在假设什么、在哪些极限下成立。
summary.technical_approach: 论文主张把奖励模型从标量函数扩展为分布式奖励模型 p(r|x,y)。在 Bayesian inference 和 KL-distributionally robust optimization 两个视角下，KL 正则化的 RLHF 目标都可导出同一个有效奖励形式：\u007etilde r(x,y)=\u00b1\u03b2 log E_p[exp(\u00b1 r/\u03b2)]。其中乐观/悲观分支分别对应风险偏好不同的策略更新；悲观分支进一步统一了 mean aggregation、worst-case optimization 和 uncertainty-weighted optimization，说明这些启发式其实是同一表达式的极限或截断近似。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集和完整实验表，重点更像理论推导与方法统一，而非大规模经验结论。可预期实验会围绕不同 RM ensemble 聚合方式在 reward hacking 场景下的行为差异展开，但从当前信息看，最值得读的是公式推导和对已有方法假设的拆解，而不是追求某个 benchmark 数字。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses a core source of reward hacking in RLHF: scalar reward models cannot represent uncertainty, so the policy can systematically exploit reward-model errors.
summary_en.importance: This is a theory-leaning post-training paper. The value is not a brand-new RLHF algorithm, but a clean unification of pessimistic reward shaping through a distributional reward-model view, placing several existing ensemble aggregation heuristics under one closed-form objective.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper replaces scalar reward models with a distributional reward model p(r|x,y). Under either a Bayesian inference view or a KL-distributionally robust optimization view, the KL-regularized RLHF objective yields the same effective reward: \u007etilde r(x,y)=\u00b1\u03b2 log E_p[exp(\u00b1 r/\u03b2)]. The optimistic/pessimistic branches correspond to different risk attitudes, and the pessimistic branch recovers mean aggregation, worst-case optimization, and uncertainty-weighted optimization as limits or truncations of the same expression.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not expose model scale, datasets, or a full empirical setup. The paper appears more about theoretical derivation and conceptual unification than large-scale empirical claims. The main value is likely in the derivation and in clarifying what existing ensemble rules implicitly assume, rather than in benchmark wins.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在想 RL 信号能否反哺 pretrain，这篇值得看公式而不是看结果：它把 RM ensemble 的几种土办法收进一个风险敏感目标里，能直接指导你怎么设计更稳的 reward aggregation。
recommendation.en: Read this for the objective, not the leaderboard: it collapses several ad-hoc RM ensemble rules into one risk-sensitive reward, which is exactly the kind of cleanup that can improve RL signals upstream.

paper.title: Follow-Your-Preference++: Rethinking Preference Alignment for Image Inpainting
paper.abstract: We study preference alignment for image inpainting. Rather than proposing yet another method, we revisit the problem from first principles and reassess its core challenges. We adopt the widely used direct preference optimization framework and construct preference training data with publicly available reward models. Our empirical study spans nine reward models, two benchmarks, and two baseline inpainting models that differ in architecture and generative mechanism. Our main findings are: (1) Most

summary.core_problem: 重新评估图像修复中的 preference alignment：公开 reward model 生成的偏好数据是否可靠，以及这些 reward 是否会诱发 reward hacking。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态生成对齐的经验分析，不是新模型；价值在于把 DPO、reward bias、candidate/sample scaling 和 reward ensemble 放到图像修复场景中系统测量，对 LLM 后训练中的 reward 信号质量有间接参照。
summary.technical_approach: 采用直接偏好优化框架，用 9 个公开 reward model 构造偏好训练数据，在两个 benchmark 和两个架构/生成机制不同的 inpainting baseline 上比较；重点分析 reward 作为训练信号和评估器时的差异、亮度/构图/色彩偏置，以及简单 reward ensemble 的稳健性。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 9 个 reward model、2 个 benchmark、2 个 baseline inpainting model；摘要报告多数 reward model 可用于构造偏好数据，但部分不适合做 evaluator；偏好数据在 candidate scaling 和 sample scaling 下趋势一致，单一 reward 会有明显视觉偏置，ensemble 能缓解并提升泛化。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Zhejiang University、The University of Tokyo、Tsinghua University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper re-examines preference alignment for image inpainting, asking whether public reward models provide reliable preference data and whether they induce reward hacking.
summary_en.importance: This is an empirical study of multimodal generative alignment rather than a new generator. Its useful signal for LLM researchers is the measurement of reward quality, reward bias, scaling of preference data, and reward ensembling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study applies Direct Preference Optimization, constructs preference data from nine public reward models, and evaluates two inpainting benchmarks with two baseline models that differ in architecture and generation mechanism. It separates reward models as training-signal providers from reward models as evaluators.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments span nine reward models, two benchmarks, and two inpainting baselines. The abstract reports that most reward models give usable preference signals, some fail as evaluators, candidate/sample scaling trends are consistent, and ensemble rewards mitigate brightness, composition, and color-scheme biases.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Zhejiang University, The University of Tokyo, and Tsinghua University.

recommendation.zh: 只看 reward bias 与 ensemble 部分；图像修复结论不能外推到 LLM，但 reward-as-data 和 reward-as-evaluator 的拆分有用。
recommendation.en: Read only the reward-bias and ensemble analysis; inpainting results do not transfer directly to LLMs, but the reward-as-data versus reward-as-evaluator split is useful.

paper.title: Skill-RM: Unifying Heterogeneous Evaluation Criteria via Agent Skill
paper.abstract: Reward models (RMs) provide critical feedback signals for LLM post-training, notably in reinforced fine-tuning (RFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) pipelines. However, current reward evaluation relies on heterogeneous criteria such as rule-based verifiers, ground-truth references, procedural checklists, and complex rubrics, where a unified mechanism to integrate all types of evidence remains unexplored. To this end, we propose Skill Reward Model (Skill-RM), a unified framework that reformulates

summary.core_problem: 当前 reward model 需整合多种异构评测依据（规则验证器、参考答案、流程 checklist、复杂 rubric 等），但现有 RM 设计要么将复杂证据压缩为不可解释的标量分数，要么依赖非结构化 flat-prompting 把所有资源拼接进一个 prompt，缺乏统一的可复用抽象来编排、选择和聚合异构证据。
summary.importance: 将 reward modeling 重新表述为一个可执行的 agent skill，从被动吸收评测知识变为主动编排资源选择与执行。为 RL/RFT 的 reward 质量提供了一条更可解释且可扩展的路径。
summary.technical_approach: Skill-RM 的核心是把 reward modeling 重新定义为执行一个可复用的『Reward-Evaluation Skill』。这个 skill 遵循 agent skill 中定义的自包含文件系统包：包含 SKILL.md 主文档（编码评测流程）、辅助脚本与资源、元数据。评测时系统执行一个结构化工作流：识别适用标准、选择性调用资源、聚合标准级证据 → 最终 reward。相比 LLM-as-Judge 中的 flat-prompting（仅添加上下文）或原子工具调用（暴露独立可执行文件），skill 封装了编排逻辑——决定何时调用什么资源、如何综合输出如何综合结果。
summary.experiments: 在主流 benchmark 上进行了 best-of-N 重排序和 RFT 实验，Skill-RM 一致优于传统 judge baseline。消融实验确认收益来自 skill 介导的证据编排，而非单纯增加上下文或工具可用性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读。重点看 Introduction 中对现有 RM 痛点的分析和 Figure 1 的框架图。预计阅读时间约 15 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 机构作者信息未在文中明确标注。

summary_en.core_problem: Reward models must integrate heterogeneous evaluation criteria (rule-based verifiers, ground-truth references, procedural checklists, complex rubrics, etc.). Existing RM designs either compress evidence into uninterpretable scalar scores or rely on unstructured flat-prompting that concatenates all resources into a single prompt, lacking a unified, reusable abstraction for orchestrating, selecting, and aggregating heterogeneous evidence.
summary_en.importance: Reformulates reward modeling as the execution of an executable agent skill, shifting from passive absorption of evaluation knowledge to active orchestration of resource selection and execution. Provides a more interpretable and scalable path for improving reward quality in RL/RFT.
summary_en.technical_approach: Skill-RM redefines reward modeling as executing a reusable 'Reward-Evaluation Skill'. The skill follows the agent-skill abstraction: a self-contained filesystem package containing a main SKILL.md document (encoding the evaluation procedure), auxiliary scripts and resources, and metadata. At evaluation time, the system executes a structured workflow: identify applicable criteria, selectively invoke relevant resources, aggregate criterion-level evidence into a final reward. Unlike flat-prompting (merely adding context) or atomic tool-use (exposing isolated executables), a skill encapsulates orchestration logic—determining what resources to consult, when to invoke them, and how to synthesize outputs.
summary_en.experiments: Extensive experiments on major benchmarks including best-of-N re-ranking and RFT show Skill-RM consistently outperforms traditional judge baselines. Ablation studies confirm gains stem from skill-mediated evidence orchestration rather than merely increased context or tool availability.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the analysis of RM pain points in the Introduction and the framework diagram in Figure 1. Estimated reading time ~15 min.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutional affiliation not explicitly stated in the paper.

recommendation.zh: 将奖励建模转化为智能体任务的思路很有启发性，关注§4的动态证据聚合机制，可用于预训练后期的对齐信号优化。
recommendation.en: The idea of framing reward modeling as an agent task is insightful; focus on Section 4's dynamic evidence aggregation mechanism for alignment signal optimization in late pretraining.

paper.title: HARVE: Hacking-Aware Reward-Head Vector Editing for Robust Reward Models
paper.abstract: Reward models are central to large language model (LLM) alignment, but they remain vulnerable to reward hacking. To evaluate reward-model robustness, we introduce RewardHackBench containing 13 reward-hacking patterns covering real life high-stakes domains and general settings, and we find severe failures on specific subcategories across eight reward models. To mitigate these failures, we propose HARVE, a training-free reward-head editing method for scalar reward models. Instead of fine-tuning th

summary.core_problem: 奖励模型（Reward Model）容易被 reward hacking 攻击——模型利用与奖励相关的表面线索（如长度、文风）来获得高分，而不真正提升事实正确性或推理质量。现有 benchmark 对法律/合规等高风险专业领域的 reward hacking 覆盖不足，且现有缓解方法依赖微调，成本高且难以快速应对新攻击模式。
summary.importance: 构建了首个覆盖法律/政策/合规专业领域的 reward hacking benchmark（RewardHackBench），并提出了一种无需训练的奖励头向量编辑方法（HARVE），通过识别并移除 reward head 向量在 hacking 子空间上的分量来提升鲁棒性，为奖励模型的安全对齐提供了轻量、可解释的干预手段。
summary.technical_approach: (1) RewardHackBench：1,203 对 gold-hacked 匹配样本，覆盖 13 个子类别，分为 5 大类（表面形式模仿、错误推理、谄媚攻击、离题攻击、重风格轻内容）。专业领域部分由纽约州执业律师起草/修订，经 3 名美国法学院学生审核，hacked/gold 词数比均值 1.01 以控制长度混淆。(2) HARVE：从选定 hacking 子类别的残差流方向中识别多维 hacking 子空间，移除 reward head 向量 w_r 在该子空间上的分量。无需梯度更新或微调，仅需少量对比样本。
summary.experiments: 评测 8 个开源 scalar reward 模型（0.6B-20B 参数）。基线结果显示所有模型在至少一个子类别上表现平庸，部分模型在特定攻击下低于随机水平（如 GRM-Llama-3.2-3B 在 Hedge Stripping 上仅 21.43%）。HARVE 在 RewardHackBench 上达到最优性能，目标子类别的 gold-preference rate 比原始 reward 模型提升 21.1 个百分点，比微调基线提升 13.7 个百分点；在非目标子类别上基本保持性能，RM-Bench 上提升 2.4 个百分点。消融实验表明编辑的方向捕捉了超越字面长度的表达模式。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 §3 的 HARVE 算法细节（子空间识别方法、向量编辑公式）和 §2 的 benchmark 构建方法论（专业领域的人-LLM 协作构建流程）。表 1 的 baseline 评测结果和 §4 的消融实验值得关注。预计阅读时间 20-30 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 作者及机构信息未在提供的内容中明确列出。

summary_en.core_problem: Reward models are vulnerable to reward hacking — models exploit surface-level reward-correlated cues (length, style) for high scores without improving factual correctness or reasoning quality. Existing benchmarks undercover high-stakes professional domains (law, compliance), and current mitigation methods rely on fine-tuning, which is costly and hard to iterate as new hacking patterns emerge.
summary_en.importance: Presents RewardHackBench, the first reward-hacking benchmark covering professional domains (law/policy/compliance), and HARVE, a training-free reward-head vector editing method that identifies and removes the hacking subspace component from the reward head vector. Provides a lightweight, interpretable intervention for reward model robustness.
summary_en.technical_approach: (1) RewardHackBench: 1,203 matched gold-hacked pairs across 13 subcategories in 5 groups (Surface-Form Mimicry, Broken Reasoning, Sycophantic Hacking, Off-Topic Hacking, Style-Over-Substance). Professional-domain portion drafted/revised by New York Bar-admitted attorneys, reviewed by 3 U.S. law students, with mean hacked-to-gold word-count ratio of 1.01 to control length confounds. (2) HARVE: identifies a multi-directional hacking subspace from residual-stream directions of selected hacking subcategories, then removes the component of the reward-head vector w_r aligned with that subspace. No gradient updates or fine-tuning required.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 8 open-source scalar reward models (0.6B-20B params). Baseline results show every model has at least one mediocre subcategory, with some performing below chance on specific attacks (e.g., GRM-Llama-3.2-3B at 21.43% on Hedge Stripping). HARVE achieves the best RewardHackBench performance: +21.1pp gold-preference rate over the original reward model and +13.7pp over the fine-tuning baseline on target subcategories; largely preserves non-target subcategory performance and gains +2.4pp on RM-Bench. Ablations confirm edited directions capture presentation patterns beyond literal length.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on §3 for HARVE algorithm details (subspace identification, vector editing formula) and §2 for benchmark construction methodology (human-LLM pipeline for professional domains). Table 1 baseline evaluation and §4 ablations are key. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Author and institution information not explicitly provided in the available content.

recommendation.zh: 建议看 benchmark taxonomy 和 head-edit 公式；结论别外推到 RL 训练闭环前。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark taxonomy and the reward-head edit; do not extrapolate the result to full RL loops without closed-loop evidence.

paper.title: Latent Reward Steering: An Adaptive Inference-Time Framework that Implicitly Promotes Cognitive Behaviors in Reasoning LLMs
paper.abstract: Strong reasoning depends not only on model knowledge but also on how effectively cognitive behaviors are deployed during generation. Existing methods often rely on explicit behavior-level control, making them insufficiently adaptive when failures and required corrections vary across reasoning states, tasks, and models. To this end, we propose Latent Reward Steering (LRS), an adaptive inference-time framework that promotes cognitive behaviors by optimizing the sparse-autoencoder (SAE) latent stat

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的不是“模型不会推理”，而是“模型在推理过程中不能稳定地调用合适的认知行为”。作者关注的失效点很具体：同一个模型明明具备验证、回退、修正假设这类能力，但在实际生成时，这些行为是否被触发、何时触发、触发强度多大，往往取决于局部状态，因而容易在早期一步走偏后持续漂移。现有方法要么靠提示词显式要求某种行为，要么先定义一个行为方向再做表示干预，问题在于它们都预设了“该推什么行为”，缺少对当前推理状态的自适应性。LRS 试图把这个问题改写成：不直接指定 verification 或 backtracking，而是学习一个对中间 latent state 打分的 reward model，在推理时沿 reward 梯度微调 latent，让模型更容易走到那些最终能导向正确答案的内部状态。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在于它提升了多少 benchmark，而在于它提出了一种新的 inference-time control 接口：把“认知行为控制”从显式行为标签，转成对稀疏 latent 的隐式优化。这个接口有三点启发。第一，它把 SAE latent 当作 reasoning state 的可操作坐标系，而不是只做解释分析，这对 mechanistic interpretability 与 test-time intervention 的结合很有参考价值。第二，它把 reward modeling 从输出级别前移到中间表示级别，和 process reward、latent verifier、test-time scaling 这些方向是相通的。第三，它说明很多推理增益可能来自更好地调用模型已有机制，而不是再训练一个新能力模块。局限也很明显：它依赖高质量 SAE、依赖可泛化的 latent reward、并且属于推理时外挂式方法，对预训练本身的 recipe 没有直接改写能力，所以更像 pretrain-posttrain 接口上的研究，而不是预训练主线方法。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由三部分组成。第一部分是表示空间选择。作者不直接改 dense hidden state，而是取冻结推理模型某一层的 hidden activation，经预训练 SAE 编码成稀疏 latent z。这样做的理由是 dense state 维度高且纠缠，难以稳定优化；SAE latent 更稀疏，也更接近可分解的功能单元。第二部分是 latent reward model。作者从成功与失败的 reasoning traces 中抽取中间 latent state，用最终答案正确性作为监督，训练一个 reward model 估计当前 latent 的“健康度”或“未来可达正确解的潜力”。这里的关键不是给每一步人工标注行为，而是让 reward model 从结果反推哪些中间状态更像好轨迹上的状态。第三部分是 inference-time latent optimization。生成时，对当前 token 对应的 latent z_t 计算 reward 梯度，沿提升 reward 的方向做小步修正，再解码回 hidden state 继续后续生成。为了避免全程硬推导致过度干预，作者加入了双门控：reward gate 只在 reward 低、疑似脆弱状态时介入；confidence gate 则利用模型自身置信度，避免在模型已经稳定的步骤上乱动。论文还强调使用的是 state-specific correction，而不是预先学一个全局 steering vector；这正是它与传统 representation steering 的主要区别。后者通常先定义“verification direction”之类的固定方向，再在所有样本上套用；LRS 则让每个时刻的修正方向由当前 latent 和 reward model 共同决定。
summary.experiments: 从全文可见，实验设计主要围绕三件事：跨模型泛化、跨任务稳健性、以及干预机制是否真的在“脆弱步骤”上起作用。作者在多个 reasoning LLM 和若干高难 benchmark 上比较了 LRS 与原始解码、prompt-based 行为诱导、以及已有 latent steering 方法。结论是 LRS 的提升较稳定，且通常优于显式行为控制基线，尤其在需要中途修正的题目上更明显。论文的定性案例显示，LRS 常见的收益模式不是让模型写出更长链条，而是在关键节点补出检查、否定前提、改写子目标等动作。消融部分重点看三项：去掉 reward gate 后，收益下降且更容易破坏原本正确的轨迹；去掉 confidence gate 后，干预范围过大，说明“只在脆弱状态介入”是必要条件；把 reward-gradient 优化换成固定 steering direction 后，效果回落，支持作者关于自适应修正优于预定义行为方向的主张。由于给出的全文片段未包含完整结果表和具体数值，我不能可靠填入参数量、数据规模和精确提升幅度；但从方法描述看，作者使用的是现成 released SAE，并在冻结 base model 的前提下额外训练 latent reward model，计算成本主要增加在每步额外前向/反向求梯度与 SAE 编解码上，而不是模型重训。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先抓三处。第一看 Introduction 里对问题的界定：作者不是在做一般意义上的 hallucination control，而是在做 reasoning trajectory 上的局部纠偏。第二看 Method 中 SAE latent、reward model、双门控三者如何串起来，这是方法是否成立的核心。第三看案例分析和消融，尤其是哪些步骤被 gate 打开、哪些错误被修正，这比总分更能说明方法到底在干什么。阅读顺序建议是：先看方法总图和算法流程，再看 reward model 的训练数据构造，再看 ablation。预计 25–35 分钟可以把主线读清。若要深挖，重点问三个问题：reward model 学到的是“正确性先验”还是“行为质量”；梯度更新是否会把 latent 推出 SAE 的可信流形；以及这种方法对不同层、不同 SAE 质量是否敏感。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in reasoning LLMs: models often possess useful cognitive routines such as verification, backtracking, and hypothesis revision, but they fail to deploy them at the right moment during generation. Existing control methods usually operate at the level of explicit behaviors—either through prompting or through predefined steering directions tied to named behaviors. That makes them brittle when the required correction depends on the local reasoning state rather than on a fixed behavior template. LRS reframes the problem as latent-state optimization: instead of telling the model to “verify now,” it learns a reward model over intermediate sparse latents and nudges the current latent toward regions associated with successful reasoning traces.
summary_en.importance: The main value is conceptual. It proposes a new test-time control interface for reasoning: optimize internal sparse latents with a learned reward, rather than injecting explicit behavior instructions. That matters for three reasons. First, it turns SAE latents from an interpretability tool into an intervention space. Second, it moves reward modeling from output space to hidden-state space, which connects naturally to process supervision, latent verifiers, and inference-time scaling. Third, it supports the view that some reasoning gains come from better deployment of mechanisms already present in the model, not from adding new capabilities through retraining. The limitations are also clear: the method depends on the quality of the SAE basis, on the generalization of the latent reward model, and on extra inference-time computation. So this is more relevant as a pretrain–posttrain interface and a mechanistic control idea than as a direct pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has three core components. First, it chooses a controllable representation space. Rather than editing dense hidden states directly, the model maps a selected layer activation into a sparse latent code using a pretrained sparse autoencoder. The motivation is straightforward: dense activations are high-dimensional and entangled, while SAE latents are sparser and easier to optimize locally. Second, it trains a latent reward model. Intermediate latent states are collected from successful and unsuccessful reasoning traces, and final answer correctness is used as supervision to estimate how promising a latent state is. Importantly, the reward model is not trained on manually labeled behaviors such as verification or decomposition. It learns from outcome supervision which internal states tend to lie on trajectories that eventually succeed. Third, at inference time, the current latent is updated using the gradient of the reward model, then decoded back into the model’s hidden space for continued generation. To avoid over-intervention, LRS adds two gates: a reward gate that activates only on low-reward, fragile-looking states, and a confidence gate that suppresses edits when the model already appears confident and stable. This is the key distinction from standard representation steering. Traditional steering uses a fixed direction associated with a predefined behavior; LRS computes a state-dependent correction direction from the current latent and the learned reward landscape.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental story is organized around three questions: whether the method transfers across reasoning models, whether it helps across multiple reasoning benchmarks, and whether the gains really come from intervening on fragile steps rather than from generic perturbation. The paper reports consistent improvements over vanilla decoding and over explicit behavior-control baselines, with stronger gains on problems that require mid-trajectory correction. The qualitative examples are informative: LRS often helps by triggering local checking, rejecting an earlier assumption, or revising a subgoal, rather than by simply producing longer chains of thought. The ablations are especially important. Removing the reward gate reduces gains and increases damage to already-correct trajectories, which supports the claim that intervention should be selective. Removing the confidence gate broadens intervention too much and hurts stability. Replacing reward-gradient updates with a fixed steering direction also weakens performance, which is evidence for the paper’s central claim that adaptive state-specific edits are better than predefined behavior vectors. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the final result tables, so I cannot safely quote exact model sizes, training set sizes, or improvement margins. What is clear is that the base reasoning model stays frozen, the SAE is reused from prior work, and the main added cost comes from training the latent reward model and computing test-time gradients through it.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, focus on three parts. Start with the problem framing in the introduction: the paper is about local reasoning-state correction, not generic hallucination reduction. Then read the method section carefully enough to understand how SAE latents, the latent reward model, and the two gates interact. Finally, spend time on the ablations and case studies, because they reveal what the intervention is actually doing. A practical reading order is: method overview figure, reward-model training setup, inference algorithm, then ablations. Around 25 to 35 minutes should be enough to capture the main idea. If you want to go deeper, the most useful questions are whether the reward model captures true process quality or just a proxy for eventual correctness, whether gradient edits push latents off the SAE manifold, and how sensitive the method is to layer choice and SAE quality.

recommendation.zh: 将 SAE 与 Reward Model 结合做 inference-time steering 是个有趣的思路，值得关注其在复杂推理任务上的泛化能力，重点看 §4 的干预机制设计。
recommendation.en: Combining SAE with Reward Model for inference-time steering is an interesting approach; worth checking its generalization on complex reasoning tasks, focusing on the intervention mechanism in §4.

paper.title: CARE-RL: Capability-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Mitigating Cross-Domain Conflicts
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards has achieved strong progress in reasoning-oriented LLMs, but extending it to multi-domain RL remains challenging due to reward unreliability in non-verifiable tasks and capability interference across domains. We propose CARE-RL to combine protocol-aware reward generation with capability-aware optimization for mitigating cross-domain conflicts. For non-verifiable tasks, the Protocol-Aware Generative Reward Model (PA-GRM) constructs prompt-level

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决多领域 RL 中两个常见冲突：非可验证任务缺少可靠 reward，导致 open-ended response 的训练信号不稳定；不同领域顺序或联合训练时，后续更新可能破坏已有能力。
summary.importance: 对预训练与 post-train 接口的启发在于，它把 reward 质量和参数更新方向放在同一个框架里处理。PA-GRM 试图让非可验证任务的评价协议随 prompt 改变，而不是用固定 rubric 评所有开放任务；DACSP 则把历史 RL 阶段的参数变化视为能力方向，在后续阶段调制梯度更新。贡献规模偏工程方法整合，实验提升幅度不大，但问题设置贴近多阶段训练中的 capability interference。
summary.technical_approach: CARE-RL 是一个 cascade multi-domain RL 框架。对可验证领域，直接使用任务 verifier；对非可验证领域，使用 Protocol-Aware Generative Reward Model。PA-GRM 分两步生成 reward：先根据 prompt 选择评价协议并构造 scoring schema，再对 candidate response 生成评分 trace 和标量 reward。协议分为 holistic 与 rubric 两类：前者适合创作、风格、整体连贯性等难以拆分的任务；后者适合有明确约束、可逐项检查的任务，例如规划类请求。优化侧是 Direction-Aware Capability Subspace Projection。每完成一个 RL 阶段，记录该阶段的参数增量，用 leading singular directions 近似该阶段获得的能力方向。后续阶段更新前，把待应用更新分解到这些历史方向上：与历史能力方向一致的分量放大，方向相反的分量抑制，正交分量保持不变。这样避免直接把所有梯度投影掉，也比简单 sequential training 更关注方向冲突。
summary.experiments: 作者在 Qwen2.5-7B 和 Qwen3-4B 上做多领域 RL，对比 joint training、sequential training 以及相关多领域 RL 基线。报告的主要结果是 CARE-RL 在平均分上超过最强基线：Qwen2.5-7B 提升 +1.0 分，Qwen3-4B 提升 +0.9 分。实验声称 PA-GRM 改善非可验证任务 reward 适配性，DACSP 缓解跨领域能力退化。需要重点核对各领域分项结果，因为平均分提升较小，方法是否真的减少 interference，要看旧领域保持率、新领域学习幅度和 PA-GRM/DACSP 分别移除后的结果。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 分钟。先看 Methodology 的整体流程图，明确 PA-GRM 负责 reward 构造，DACSP 负责 update modulation。PA-GRM 部分重点看 holistic/rubric 路由逻辑、schema 生成方式和 Appendix B 的 prompt templates。DACSP 部分重点看参数增量如何形成低秩 capability subspace，以及 aligned/opposing/orthogonal components 如何被调制。实验部分优先看每个领域的分项指标、PA-GRM 与 DACSP 消融、顺序训练下旧能力是否下降。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses two coupled problems in multi-domain RL for LLMs: open-ended tasks often lack reliable rewards, and sequential or joint optimization across domains can cause capability interference, where later updates degrade skills learned in earlier stages.
summary_en.importance: The useful angle is the joint treatment of reward construction and update direction. PA-GRM adapts the evaluation protocol to each prompt instead of applying one fixed rubric to all non-verifiable tasks. DACSP uses parameter changes from previous RL stages as low-rank capability directions and modulates later updates according to their alignment. The contribution is more of a practical framework than a new RL objective, and the reported gains are modest, but the setting is relevant to multi-stage post-training and continual adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: CARE-RL organizes training as a cascade over domains. Verifiable domains use task-specific verifiers. Non-verifiable domains use a Protocol-Aware Generative Reward Model. PA-GRM first selects an evaluation protocol and builds a prompt-level scoring schema, then scores each candidate response under that schema with a trace-conditioned generative reward. It supports holistic evaluation for tasks such as creative writing, where quality is hard to decompose, and rubric-based evaluation for tasks with explicit constraints. The optimization component, Direction-Aware Capability Subspace Projection, records the parameter delta after each completed RL stage and extracts leading singular directions as a proxy for acquired capability directions. For later stages, the proposed update is decomposed relative to these historical subspaces: aligned components are amplified, opposing components are suppressed, and orthogonal components are left unchanged.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are conducted on Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen3-4B in a multi-domain RL setting. CARE-RL reports the best average score among the compared methods, improving over the strongest baseline by +1.0 points on Qwen2.5-7B and +0.9 points on Qwen3-4B. The paper attributes the gains to better reward adaptation on non-verifiable tasks and reduced cross-domain degradation from DACSP. Since the average improvements are small, the most important evidence is in the per-domain breakdown, old-domain retention after later stages, and ablations removing PA-GRM or DACSP.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 minutes. Read the methodology figure first to separate the two roles: PA-GRM constructs rewards, while DACSP modulates updates. For PA-GRM, inspect the holistic-versus-rubric routing, schema generation, scoring traces, and the prompt templates in the appendix. For DACSP, focus on how parameter deltas are converted into low-rank capability subspaces and how update components are amplified or suppressed. In the experiments, prioritize per-domain scores, ablations, and evidence of reduced forgetting under sequential training.

recommendation.zh: 多域RL对齐的能力保留思路对后训练有参考价值，重点看§3的子空间投影方法即可
recommendation.en: The capability subspace projection for multi-domain RL alignment is useful for post-training research, focus on Section 3 only.

Recent work has explored the zero-shot reasoning capabilities of pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as reward models. However, without careful prompt engineering, these approaches tend to produce suboptimal rewards, where false positive predictions can severely degrade downstream policy learning. summary.core_problem: 预训练视觉语言模型 (VLM) 作为零样本奖励模型时，未经优化的 prompt 容易产生大量假阳性奖励（误判未完成的任务为成功），导致 RL 训练中的 reward hacking 问题——策略会去追求 VLM 认为有价值但实际不符合任务目标的状态。而在机器人等场景中，奖励函数本身难以人工设计，通常只能获得少量专家演示。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于：展示了如何在不微调模型参数的情况下，通过少量数据在测试时自动优化 reward model 的 prompt，这与 LLM 对齐中 reward model 的工程设计有间接关联。这种用少量演示自动校准 reward signal 的思路可能对 RLHF 等场景有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: Demo2Reward 是一种测试时自适应技术：在策略训练前，用少量专家演示数据自动优化 VLM 奖励模型的语言指令。具体流程：从通用任务指令开始，用 VLM 自身作为元批评家 (meta-critic)，基于采样的演示迭代优化指令，在其余演示上评估，直到错误奖励最小化。优化后的 prompt 在策略学习期间固定使用。整个过程不涉及 VLM 的微调或额外训练，运行时推理开销不变。
summary.experiments: 论文在模拟机器人任务和真实环境中进行了实验，验证了 Demo2Reward 能减少 VLM 的假阳性和假阴性奖励预测，提升跨任务、跨仿真/真实环境、跨 RL 骨干的策略学习效果。具体数值未在提供的片段中完整呈现。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 Introduction（动机）和 Method 部分；Figure 1 的示例对比直观展示了假阳性问题和改进效果。预计阅读时间 25-35 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) used as zero-shot reward models tend to produce suboptimal rewards without careful prompt engineering. False positive predictions are particularly problematic in RL for robotics, where the agent can exploit misspecified rewards (reward hacking), pursuing states that appear valuable to the VLM but do not reflect true task success. Manual reward engineering is impractical in robotics, and only a small number of expert demonstrations are typically available.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, the relevant insight is that Demo2Reward demonstrates how to automatically calibrate a reward model using only a few demonstrations, without any model fine-tuning. This test-time prompt adaptation approach for reward signal quality may have indirect relevance to RLHF and LLM alignment, where reward model calibration is also critical.
summary_en.technical_approach: Demo2Reward is a test-time adaptation scheme: before policy training, it automatically optimizes the language instruction of a VLM reward model using a small number of expert demonstrations. Starting from a generic task instruction, the method uses the VLM itself as a meta-critic to iteratively refine the instruction based on sampled demonstrations, evaluating on the remaining demonstrations until false rewards are minimized. The optimized prompt is then fixed during policy learning. No fine-tuning or additional training of the VLM is required, and runtime inference cost is unchanged.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments in simulated robotic tasks and real-world environments show that Demo2Reward reduces both false positive and false negative reward predictions from VLMs, improving policy learning across tasks, simulation/real environments, and RL backbones. Specific numerical results are not fully provided in the available fragments.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Introduction (motivation) and the Method section. Figure 1 provides clear visual examples of the false positive problem and the improvement from Demo2Reward. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 测试时 prompt 优化替代奖励模型训练的思路值得关注，但摘要截断，实验可信度不明。建议等完整版本或只看方法 §3。
recommendation.en: Test-time prompt optimization as a substitute for reward model training is interesting; abstract is truncated, experimental credibility unclear. Read §3 method only or wait for full version.

paper.title: Configurable Reward Model for Balanced Safety Alignment
paper.abstract: Aligning large language models (LLMs) to heterogeneous and rapidly evolving safety requirements remains a critical challenge. Existing instruction-tuned LLMs and standalone safety classifiers often fail to generalize to new safety configurations, motivating the need for Reward Models (RMs) that are explicitly configurable to changing specifications. We introduce the Configurable Safety Reward Model (CSRM), which is jointly optimized for calibrated safety compliance and reward modeling. Our appro

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体、也很难绕开的对齐问题：安全规范不是静态常量，而是会随场景、机构、地区和时间变化；但现有 RLHF 流水线里的 reward model 往往把“安全”固化进参数里，部署后很难改。另一条常见路线是做可配置安全分类器或 judge，但这类模型更适合做过滤，不适合做 RL 内环奖励，因为输出要么过于离散、要么校准很差，难以提供平滑、可优化的训练信号。论文要解决的核心问题，就是如何构造一种在推理时可按自然语言安全配置切换、同时又能输出稠密且有严重度感知的标量奖励模型，用于后续策略优化，并尽量减少过拒答。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，它不是直接改 pretrain recipe，但对 pretrain↔post-train 接口有现实意义。它把“可配置 judge”推进到“可配置 reward model”，重点不在判别是否违规，而在能否作为 RL 的连续优化信号使用。这件事的重要性有两层。第一，安全规范变化很快，若每次都重训 RM 和重跑 RLHF，成本高且反馈周期慢；可配置 RM 让 reward 侧更接近可编程接口。第二，很多安全系统的问题不是不会拒，而是不会在安全与帮助性之间做细粒度权衡；如果 reward 几何更平滑、更有严重度结构，策略学习更可能学到边界，而不是简单地“多拒绝”。从贡献量级看，这更像对齐基础设施的一次补全，而不是训练范式替代。对做基础模型的人，启发主要在 reward 建模、数据构造和校准，而不是模型架构本身。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 CSRM（Configurable Safety Reward Model）。它把输入组织成多轮对话上下文、候选回复以及一段自然语言形式的 safety configuration。这个 configuration 不是简单标签，而是一组带文字描述的安全类别与规则，模型需要在给定规则下判断回复的合规程度，并输出适合 RL 使用的标量 reward。

技术上有两个关键点。第一，是联合式训练，而不是把安全分类和 reward modeling 分开做。论文强调将判别式安全合规学习与生成式/排序式 reward 学习统一起来，让模型既学“是否违反规则”，也学“违反有多严重、不同回复之间谁更好”。这样做的原因很直接：单纯分类器容易把边界压得很硬，RL 时梯度信号稀；单纯偏好建模又可能缺少明确的规范锚点，尤其在配置变化时泛化差。联合目标相当于同时约束语义理解、规则遵循和 reward 几何。

第二，是 configuration-targeted data augmentation。论文不是只靠原始标注数据，而是系统性地改写安全配置的严格程度，并构造与之对应的训练样本，让模型看到“同一类内容在不同规则下可能有不同判定”的情况。这里最重要的不是扩数据量，而是保留 violation severity 的相对结构：轻微越界、边界案例、明显违规之间的顺序不能在增强时被破坏。这样模型学到的不是某条固定政策，而是“规则文本如何改变奖励面”。这和 Llama Guard、ShieldGemma、DynaGuard 这类 prompt-conditioned safety judge 的差别在于，后者主要输出类别或判断，前者则试图学出可用于策略搜索的连续 reward。

从设计取舍看，作者显然在避免两种失败模式：一是 reward 过尖，导致 RL 只学会回避；二是 reward 过平，导致安全边界不清。论文把 calibrated safety compliance 作为目标之一，说明其关注点不是只提高分类准确率，而是让 reward 的数值变化与违规严重度、配置严格度和对话语境相匹配。这一点对后续 PPO/DPO 类优化是否稳定很关键。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文内容看，实验结论主要围绕三件事。第一，CSRM 对未见过的安全配置有更好的泛化。也就是说，训练时没有显式见过的 guideline 组合或严格度变化，在推理时仍能给出相对合理的 reward。第二，作为 RL 内环奖励时，它比静态 RM 或可配置 judge 更能改善 safety-helpfulness trade-off，尤其体现在减少 over-refusal，同时维持较强安全性。第三，数据增强和联合训练都不是可有可无的装饰，消融显示它们对配置泛化和 reward 校准都有贡献。

不过，当前提供的全文片段没有完整实验表格、模型规模、训练 token 数、具体 benchmark 名称和精确数值，因此没法负责任地填入参数量、数据规模或提升百分点。能确认的是，作者做了多种 alignment setting 下的比较，并把 Pareto frontier 作为主要分析方式之一，而不是只报单点安全分数。这种评估方式是合理的，因为该方法的目标不是单纯更“严”，而是在不同安全配置下给策略学习提供更可控的优化方向。

如果拿它和常见安全 judge 比，实验想证明的不是 judge 不会判，而是 judge 的输出形状不适合 RL；如果拿它和传统静态 RM 比，实验想证明的则是 inference-time configurability 不必以 reward usability 为代价。真正值得注意的消融，应该是：去掉 targeted augmentation 后，对 unseen config 的性能下降多少；去掉联合目标后，reward 是否变得更不稳定或更容易过拒；不同 strictness 配置下，reward 分布是否仍保持单调和可分性。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合带着“reward geometry”这个问题去读，而不是把它当普通安全分类论文。优先看 Introduction 里对静态 RM、可配置 judge 和 RL 内环需求之间矛盾的界定，作者的问题设定是成立与否的关键。然后重点看方法部分 3.2 和 3.3：一个讲 targeted augmentation，另一个讲 joint objective。读的时候要盯住两个问题：增强样本如何保证严重度顺序不被破坏；联合训练里分类信号和偏好/奖励信号是怎样耦合的。

实验部分建议先看主表和 Pareto frontier 图，再看 unseen configuration 的泛化实验。若时间有限，先确认三件事：1）它是否真的优于 prompt-conditioned judge 作为 reward；2）收益主要来自配置条件化，还是来自更好的数据构造；3）它减少 over-refusal 的证据是否扎实，还是只是换了评测口径。

预计泛读 25–35 分钟可以抓住主线；若要精读，值得深挖 reward calibration 的定义、训练标签来源、以及 RL 阶段具体如何接入。还可以顺手思考一个更大的问题：这种“自然语言配置→reward 面变化”的做法，是否能推广到非安全维度，例如风格、品牌约束、工具使用规范等。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific alignment bottleneck: safety requirements are heterogeneous and change over time, but standard RLHF pipelines rely on a static reward model with safety preferences baked into the parameters. When policies change, the usual answer is to retrain the RM and rerun alignment. Configurable safety classifiers and prompt-conditioned judges avoid retraining, but they are poor inner-loop rewards: their outputs are often too discrete, too peaky, or too weakly calibrated to support stable policy optimization. The core problem here is how to build a reward model that can condition on natural-language safety specifications at inference time while still producing a dense scalar reward that reflects violation severity and is usable for RL.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it matters for the pretrain-to-post-train interface. The contribution is less about model architecture and more about reward infrastructure. It moves from configurable judging to configurable reward modeling. That distinction matters because RL needs a smooth optimization signal, not just a policy gate. The practical value is clear: if safety requirements evolve faster than retraining cycles, a configurable RM becomes a more realistic control surface than a frozen RM. The second reason it matters is the safety-helpfulness trade-off. Many deployed systems fail not because they cannot refuse unsafe requests, but because they collapse toward over-refusal under uncertainty. A reward model with better calibration and severity structure can, in principle, teach a policy where the boundary is, instead of teaching it to reject broadly. The contribution looks like an important systems-level extension to alignment pipelines rather than a new training paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is the Configurable Safety Reward Model (CSRM). The model takes a conversation context, a candidate response, and a natural-language safety configuration. The configuration is not a simple class label; it is a textual specification of safety categories and guidelines. The model must score the response under that specification and output a scalar reward suitable for downstream policy optimization.

Two ideas carry most of the paper. First, the training is joint rather than split across separate modules. The model is optimized for both safety compliance and reward modeling, so it learns not only whether a response violates a rule, but also how severe the violation is and how candidate responses should be ranked under a given configuration. This is a deliberate design choice. A pure classifier tends to produce hard boundaries and sparse learning signals. A pure preference model may lack explicit normative anchors and can generalize poorly when the policy text changes. The joint objective is meant to tie together rule understanding, contextual safety judgment, and usable reward geometry.

Second, the paper introduces configuration-targeted data augmentation. Instead of only training on fixed policy annotations, it systematically varies the strictness and wording of safety configurations and constructs corresponding examples. The key is not just more data, but preserving the relative severity structure across examples. Borderline cases, mild violations, and severe violations must remain ordered after augmentation. This teaches the model how reward should change when the policy text changes. That is the main difference from prompt-conditioned safety judges such as Llama Guard or ShieldGemma. Those systems are optimized to classify or judge. CSRM is optimized to produce a calibrated scalar signal that can sit inside RL.

The design is trying to avoid two failure modes at once: rewards that are too sharp and induce blanket refusal, and rewards that are too flat and fail to define a meaningful boundary. The emphasis on calibrated safety compliance suggests that the authors care about the numerical shape of the reward, not just classification accuracy. That is exactly the part that matters if the model is later used in PPO-like or other policy optimization loops.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full text, the experimental story has three main claims. First, CSRM generalizes better to unseen safety configurations. In other words, the model can handle guideline combinations or strictness settings that were not explicitly seen during training. Second, when used as an inner-loop reward, it improves the safety-helpfulness trade-off relative to static reward models and configurable judges, especially by reducing over-refusal while maintaining strong safety behavior. Third, both targeted augmentation and joint training matter: the ablations indicate that these components contribute to configuration generalization and reward calibration.

That said, the supplied text does not include the full result tables, model sizes, training data counts, benchmark names, or exact gains, so it would be unsafe to invent parameter scales or percentage improvements. What is clear is that the paper evaluates multiple alignment settings and emphasizes Pareto-frontier analysis rather than a single safety score. That is the right evaluation lens here, because the goal is not simply to become stricter, but to provide a controllable reward under varying safety specifications.

The most important comparisons are conceptual. Against configurable judges, the paper aims to show not that judges cannot detect violations, but that their output geometry is ill-suited for RL. Against static RMs, it aims to show that inference-time configurability does not have to come at the cost of reward usability. The ablations worth checking closely are: how much unseen-configuration performance drops without targeted augmentation, whether removing the joint objective makes rewards less stable or more refusal-prone, and whether reward distributions remain monotonic across different strictness settings.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this as a reward-modeling paper, not as a standard safety-classification paper. Start with the introduction, especially the contrast between static RMs, configurable judges, and the requirements of inner-loop RL. If that problem framing is weak, the rest matters less; if it is strong, the paper becomes much more relevant.

Then go straight to the method section on targeted augmentation and the joint objective. Two questions are worth tracking while reading: how the augmentation preserves severity ordering, and how the compliance signal is coupled with the reward-learning signal. Those details determine whether the model is learning policy text semantics or just memorizing templates.

In the experiments, look first at the main comparison tables and any Pareto-frontier plots, then at the unseen-configuration generalization results. If time is limited, verify three things: whether CSRM is actually better than prompt-conditioned judges as an RL reward, whether the gains mainly come from configuration conditioning or from better data construction, and whether the evidence for reduced over-refusal is robust rather than metric-dependent.

A quick read should take about 25 to 35 minutes. A deeper read is worthwhile if you care about reward calibration, label construction, and how configurable textual constraints can be turned into optimization signals. One broader question to keep in mind is whether this recipe could extend beyond safety to other controllable dimensions such as style, brand constraints, or tool-use policies.

recommendation.zh: 不是范式突破，但把“安全规范条件化”放进 RM 本身这件事是对的；若你做对齐数据与 RM，优先看数据增强和未见配置泛化实验。
recommendation.en: Not a paradigm shift, but conditioning the RM on explicit safety configurations is the right move; if you work on alignment data or reward models, read the augmentation design and unseen-config generalization tables.

summary.core_problem: 这篇短文想回答一个更基础的问题：在给定成对偏好分布时，用“模型是否把 preferred response 排在 rejected response 之前”这个检验，究竟在估计什么模型层面的量。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是测量定义而不是新训练方法。它把常见的 pairwise preference accuracy 形式化为一个 model-level ordinal observable，并给出中心化统计量、margin 扩展以及有限样本估计与集中界。对做对齐、reward modeling、judge 设计的人有概念澄清价值，但对预训练本身的直接推动有限。
summary.technical_approach: 作者定义了基于参考分布 P_pair(x, y+, y-) 和模型标量打分函数 S_M(x, y) 的 pairwise reference alignment：即模型诱导排序与参考偏好排序一致的概率。进一步给出一个类似 order parameter 的中心化统计量，并讨论 margin-based 版本。方法上更像统计测量框架，核心是把常用 pairwise ranking 指标解释为可估计的序量观测量，而不是提出新的优化目标或新模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要里没有看到新的大规模模型实验，也明确说明没有引入新的训练算法、数据集或基准。实验部分大概率以定义、估计器和理论性质为主，价值在于统一解释 pairwise preference evaluation，而不是展示性能提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The note asks a basic measurement question: given a reference distribution of pairwise preferences, what model-level quantity is actually being estimated when we test whether a model ranks preferred responses above rejected ones?
summary_en.importance: This is a measurement clarification rather than a new training method. It formalizes pairwise preference accuracy as a model-level ordinal observable, with a centered statistic, a margin-based extension, and finite-sample concentration results. Useful for alignment and reward-model evaluation hygiene, but only indirectly relevant to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper defines pairwise reference alignment from a reference pair distribution P_pair(x, y+, y-) and a scalar model score S_M(x, y), as the probability that the model-induced ordering matches the reference ordering. It then introduces a centered order-parameter-like statistic and discusses a margin-aware variant. The contribution is a statistical framing of an existing practice, not a new optimization or modeling recipe.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not indicate new large-scale model experiments and explicitly says no new training algorithm, dataset, or benchmark is introduced. The empirical side appears limited to estimators and theoretical properties rather than capability gains.

recommendation.zh: 偏概念澄清，不会改变训练做法；如果你在做 RM/judge 评测口径统一，可只看定义和 concentration bound，其余略过。
recommendation.en: Mostly a measurement note, not a training paper; read the definition and concentration result if you care about RM/judge metric hygiene, otherwise skip.

paper.title: The Flip Side of RLHF: On-Policy Feedback for Reward Model Self-Supervised Improvement
paper.abstract: Building strong reward models (RMs) for language model alignment is bottlenecked by the cost and difficulty of acquiring diverse and reliable preference data from human annotation or judge models. It is dramatically worse as the policy evolves beyond the static RM training. Therefore, we propose SAVE (Self-supervised reward model improvement via Value-Anchored On-policy feedback), a framework that grades on-policy responses as feedback by using the value function for on-policy RM training. SAVE

summary.core_problem: RLHF 里 reward model（RM）训练通常依赖离线偏好数据，随着 policy 在 RL 中持续更新，RM 会与当前 on-policy 分布逐渐失配，导致校准变差、被 Goodhart 放大并出现 reward hacking。论文要解决的是：在不增加人工标注、也不依赖外部 judge 的前提下，能否利用 RL 过程中自然产生的 on-policy 轨迹，让 RM 自我改进并跟上 policy 的分布漂移。
summary.importance: 对齐训练里“RM 迭代成本高、RM 跟不上 policy”是长期瓶颈。SAVE 把 critic/value 的信息回流到 RM 训练，提供了一条相对闭环的 RM 持续学习路径：用 on-policy 数据 + 自监督信号替代新增偏好标注。对预训练研究的直接价值在于 pretrain↔posttrain 接口：它给出一种把 RL 训练动态（value baseline、advantage、on-policy 分布）转化为可规模化监督信号的范式，能降低 RM 数据依赖，并缓解 RM 过时带来的训练不稳定与 reward hacking 风险。
summary.technical_approach:
SAVE（Self-supervised reward model improvement via Value-Anchored On-policy feEdback）的核心是把“prompt 级别的 value”当作自适应锚点，把 on-policy 采样到的多个回答转成可训练 RM 的偏好对。

1) Value-anchored RM：在 RM 里加入一个 prompt-specific 的 value head V(x)，估计在当前采样 policy 下该 prompt 的期望 reward。这个 V(x) 不是传统 PPO critic 的必需组件，而是作为 RM 自监督标尺：同一 prompt 下，回答 y 的相对好坏用 advantage A(x,y)=R(x,y)-V(x) 来衡量。

2) 用 advantage 生成伪偏好并做过滤：对同一 prompt 的 on-policy responses，按 advantage 正负划分为“正样本/负样本”。同时引入 curriculum 式阈值，过滤 |A| 小的样本（作者称 ambiguous），避免把 RM 当前不确定区域的噪声当成强监督，降低自举式训练的漂移。

3) Contrastive / ranking 目标更新 RM：把 (x, y_pos, y_neg) 当作偏好对，用对比式的排序损失更新 RM（形式上类似 BT/对比学习，但监督来自 advantage 分组而非人工偏好）。直觉是：value 负责提供相对基线，policy 负责不断产生“RM 还没学会区分”的新样本，RM 则在这些样本上收紧排序边界并改善校准。

4) 理论视角：作者把该过程解释为 RM-centric 的 minimax：policy 优化在某种意义上充当“自适应数据生成器”，持续把采样分布推向 RM 的薄弱区；RM 则最小化在该诱导分布上的最坏情况排序/校准损失。这个表述的价值主要在于解释为什么 on-policy 数据比静态离线数据更“信息密度高”，以及为什么需要过滤机制来控制自举噪声。
summary.experiments:
论文报告在 6 个 RM 基准上评测：RewardBench、RewardBench 2、RM-Bench、PPE Preference、PPE Correctness、JudgeBench。平均准确率把初始 RM 从 76.0 提升到 77.3，并且在六个基准上都拿到最好分数（文中表述为 best scores on all six）。

下游 policy 侧：用改进后的 RM 做 RLHF，AlpacaEval 2（length-controlled win rate）从 51.68% 提升到 54.24%；Arena-Hard-v2.0 win rate 从 30.2% 提升到 33.9%。

鲁棒性：作者强调在三种 RL 算法（GRPO、RLOO、GSPO）与两个 policy backbone 上一致有效，说明方法不强绑定某个特定 RL recipe。关键消融点（从方法描述推断其必要性）应包括：无 value anchor、无 ambiguous 过滤、不同阈值/课程策略、以及不同对比目标的对比；这些通常决定自举信号是否会把 RM 带偏。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：优先看方法定义与训练信号构造。
- 重点看 §4.1（value-anchored RM 的定义、advantage 如何计算、prompt-specific value head 的实现细节）和样本过滤/课程阈值的规则。
- 重点看 §4.2 的“把 RL 目标重解释为信息反馈生成”的推导，理解作者为何认为 policy 会自然产出更有信息的 RM 训练样本。
- 实验部分建议先看 6 个 RM benchmark 的主表，再看与 RL 算法/不同 backbone 的一致性结果；最后看消融（尤其是过滤阈值与 advantage 分组策略），判断该方法对超参的敏感度。
预计阅读时间：30-45 分钟可抓住主线；若要复现或迁移到自家 RLHF pipeline，需要额外精读 value head 的训练方式与数据管线细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Reward models in RLHF are typically trained on static, offline preference data. As the policy improves during RL, the on-policy response distribution drifts away from the RM’s training distribution, causing miscalibration and making reward hacking more likely under Goodhart-style amplification. The paper asks whether an RM can continuously improve using only on-policy rollouts produced during RL—without additional human labels and without relying on an external judge model.
summary_en.importance: RM iteration cost and RM-policy mismatch are practical bottlenecks in alignment training. SAVE proposes a relatively closed-loop mechanism that turns signals already present in RL training (a value baseline and on-policy samples) into scalable supervision for RM updates. For foundation-model researchers, the main value is at the pretrain↔posttrain interface: it is a concrete recipe for converting training dynamics (advantages under the current sampling policy) into self-supervised ranking data, potentially reducing dependence on expensive preference collection and improving stability as the policy moves.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SAVE (Self-supervised reward model improvement via Value-Anchored On-policy feEdback) augments the RM with a prompt-level value head and uses advantage-based pseudo-preferences derived from on-policy rollouts.

1) Value-anchored RM: the model predicts both a scalar reward R(x,y) and a prompt-specific value V(x), where V(x) estimates the expected reward under the current sampling policy for that prompt. V(x) serves as an adaptive baseline.

2) Advantage-derived supervision: for each on-policy response y, compute an RM advantage A(x,y)=R(x,y)-V(x). Responses are split into positive-advantage and negative-advantage sets, yielding pseudo preference pairs (x, y_pos, y_neg).

3) Ambiguity filtering with a curriculum threshold: samples with small |A| are treated as ambiguous and filtered out. This is meant to control bootstrapping noise and avoid reinforcing uncertain or near-tie comparisons.

4) Contrastive/ranking objective: the RM is updated with a contrastive preference loss on the constructed pairs, analogous in spirit to Bradley–Terry training but with labels induced by advantages rather than human/judge preferences.

5) Interpretation: the authors frame the process as an RM-centric minimax game where policy optimization acts as an adaptive data generator that surfaces challenging on-policy samples, while the RM minimizes worst-case ranking/calibration loss over the induced distribution.
summary_en.experiments:
RM quality is evaluated on six benchmarks: RewardBench, RewardBench 2, RM-Bench, PPE Preference, PPE Correctness, and JudgeBench. The reported average accuracy improves from 76.0 to 77.3, and the method is reported to achieve the best score on each of the six benchmarks.

Downstream RLHF: using the improved RM increases AlpacaEval 2 length-controlled win rate from 51.68% to 54.24%, and Arena-Hard-v2.0 win rate from 30.2% to 33.9%.

Generality: gains are reported across three RL algorithms (GRPO, RLOO, GSPO) and two policy backbones, suggesting the approach is not tightly coupled to a single RL recipe. The most decision-critical ablations are the value anchor, the ambiguity filter/threshold schedule, and the exact contrastive objective.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim path:
- Focus on the section defining the value-anchored RM and how V(x) is trained/used to compute advantages; this is the core mechanism.
- Read the ambiguity filtering rule and the curriculum schedule carefully; this likely determines whether self-training remains stable.
- In experiments, first check the main table across the six RM benchmarks, then the consistency across RL algorithms/backbones, and finally the ablations around filtering and advantage construction.
Time: ~30–45 minutes to understand the idea; longer if you want to port it into an existing RLHF pipeline and need the exact data/optimization details for the value head.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是它把 value 信号回流到 RM 训练这件事；若实验控制干净，这会改变“RM 只能吃静态偏好数据”的默认设定，先读方法和消融即可。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the idea of feeding value signals back into RM training; if the controls are clean, it weakens the default assumption that RMs must rely on static preference data.
